heroicTraits.name: Prodigy of the Asydrzor
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared an **^^ASYDRAZOR^^** ability for a friendly FIRST PHALANX unit wholly within 12" of this unit
heroicTraits.effect: No **asydrazor points** are spent to use that ability.

artifacts.name: Crest of the Ionrach
artifacts.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

otherEnhancements.name: Voidchill Darkness
otherEnhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit if this unit charged this turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Deep Connection
otherEnhancements.effect: Ignore the effect of the **Companion** weapon ability on this unit’s weapons.

otherEnhancements.name: Swift-Finned Skirmisher
otherEnhancements.timing: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for this unit
otherEnhancements.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that this unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

battleTraits.name: Cutting-Edge Endrinpacks
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** units that are wholly within 9" of a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW SKYVESSEL** to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, each target can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RUN^^** ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Loyalty to the Magnate
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: While a friendly **Brokk Grungsson** is wholly within the combat range of another friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** unit, both those units have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

battleTraits.name: Pay Your Debts
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield or in reserve to be **indebted**.
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW** units that target the **indebted** unit.

battleTraits.name: Constant Barrage
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW** unit’s attacks to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move within 10" of any friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW** units, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: Invictunite-lined Hull
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW SKYVESSEL** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3. For the rest of the turn, subtract **X** from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that **^^SKYVESSEL^^**, where **X** is equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: Bold Moves
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** units that are in combat to be the targets. Make an **emergency launch roll** of 3D6 for each target.
battleTraits.effect:
Each target can move a distance up to the value of its **emergency launch roll**. It **can** move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but **cannot** end that move in combat with an enemy unit that it was not in combat with at the start of the phase.
The target(s) cannot use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Master of Discipline
heroicTraits.effect: Each time a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, you can re-roll the dice.

heroicTraits.name: Flanking Fire
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW SKYVESSELS** that target an enemy unit in combat with this unit.

artifacts.name: Aerodynamism
artifacts.effect: If this unit moved this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Guns For All Occasions
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: Call Forth the Tsunami
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have 3 or more **chorrileum spirit points**. Pick a friendly unit **awaiting a summons** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up the target anywhere on the battlefield. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with it.

battleTraits.name: Spirits of the Chorrileum
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
Each turn, you can gain up to 1 **chorrileum spirit point**. You gain 1 **chorrileum spirit point** the first time 1 of the following occurs in a turn:
• You make an unmodified casting roll of 8 or more for a friendly **^^ISHARANN WIZARD^^**.
• An enemy unit is destroyed while it is within 12" of any friendly **^^ISHARANN^^** units.
• A friendly unit is destroyed while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **^^ISHARANN^^** units or while it is contesting an objective you control

battleTraits.name: The Ocean Conceals
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: This ability must be used to deploy the friendly **CHORRILEUM EIDOLON** instead of the ‘Deploy Unit’ ability or the ‘Deploy Regiment’ ability.
battleTraits.effect: Set up the friendly **CHORRILEUM EIDOLON** in reserve **awaiting a summons**. It has now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: Wrath of Mathlann
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM EIDOLON** unit that has not used any **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: That unit can use 2 **^^FIGHT^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, that unit has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn. The unit using this ability cannot use any other **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Serve the Enclave
heroicTraits.effect: While this unit and a friendly **CHORRILEUM NAMARTI** unit are contesting the same objective, this unit has a control score of 10 that cannot be modified.

artifacts.name: Ammonite Carnyx
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM NAMARTI** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Ethereal
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT^^** units, excluding **Nagash.**

battleTraits.name: Ethereal Translocation
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT^^** unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Mounting Dread
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract the current battle round number from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT^^** units.

battleTraits.name: Sepulchral Apparitions
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.effect:
If there is a friendly **Nexus of Grief** on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional **Nexuses of Grief** on the battlefield. Each must be set up wholly outside enemy territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.
**Designer’s Note:** *The original* **Nexus of Grief** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

heroicTraits.name: Deathly Possessor
heroicTraits.declare: Pick an enemy **^^HERO^^** in combat with this unit to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target's combat range to be the victim.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target with that weapon against the victim.

heroicTraits.name: Ruler of the Spectral Hosts
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
heroicTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**^^HERO NIGHTHAUNT^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
heroicTraits.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is damaged, **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to **X,** where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.

heroicTraits.name: Shadowy Aura
heroicTraits.effect: While they are wholly within 6" of this unit, friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY^^** and **^^CAVALRY^^** units are not visible to enemy units more than 9" from them.

artifacts.name: Stave of Suffering
artifacts.effect: While this unit is within 12" of any damaged enemy units or enemy units that have had any models slain, add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Tombstone of the Penitent
artifacts.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for each non-**^^FACTION TERRAIN^^** terrain feature that is being contested by friendly units, to a maximum of 8.

artifacts.name: Amulet of Waking Nightmares
artifacts.declare: Pick a enemy **^^HERO^^** within 18" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target cannot be affected by the ‘Guarded Hero’ ability or the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability.

artifacts.name: Brazier of Nagashizzar
artifacts.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit
artifacts.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

artifacts.name: Lightshard of the Harvest Moon
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artifacts.effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Mirror of Echoing Failures
artifacts.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL or PRAYER ability for a WIZARD or PRIEST within 12" of this unit
artifacts.declare: Pick each enemy **^^WIZARD^^** and **^^PRIEST^^** within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
artifacts.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, for the rest of the phase:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the targets.
• Each time any of the targets fails to cast a spell or chant a prayer, inflict 1 mortal damage on that target.

artifacts.name: Tome of the Restless Crypts
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
artifacts.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Nexuses of Grief** on the battlefield, set up a **Nexus of Grief** within 3" of a friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT^^** unit, more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 1" from all other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.

artifacts.name: Ethereal Fetters
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: For the rest of the turn, if possible, this unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.

artifacts.name: Urn of Despondency
artifacts.effect:
Spend up to 3 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, roll **X**D6, where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the roll but must end that move in combat with a damaged enemy unit and/or an enemy unit that has fewer models than its starting size.

otherEnhancements.name: Vociferous Defamers
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT WIZARDS^^** while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit. Add 2 to casting rolls instead if this unit is also in combat with an enemy **^^WIZARD^^** or **^^PRIEST^^**.

otherEnhancements.name: Backstabbing Betrayers
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is more than 12" from all other friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT^^** units.

otherEnhancements.name: Cowards and Deserters
otherEnhancements.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
otherEnhancements.effect:
After that **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved, roll a dice. You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Add 1 to the roll.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

battleTraits.name: Scions of the Storm
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS^^** unit that is **in the**^^ ^^**Celestial Realm**.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: The Celestial Realm
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: If there are more friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS^^** units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS^^** unit that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Celestial Realm**. It has now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: Their Finest Hour
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS^^** unit that has not used this ability this battle to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit’s combat attacks and add 1 to save rolls for that unit.

battleTraits.name: Heavens-sent
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^UNIQUE STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY^^** or **^^CAVALRY^^** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Staunch Defender
heroicTraits.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective in friendly territory, add 3 to the control scores of friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS^^** units contesting that objective.

heroicTraits.name: Shock and Awe
heroicTraits.effect:
Each time this unit is set up using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the battle round.
In addition, each time a friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS^^** unit is set up wholly within 12"of this unit using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

heroicTraits.name: Envoy of the Heavens
heroicTraits.declare: If a friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS^^** unit was destroyed in the previous turn, pick a visible friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS^^** unit wholly within 12"of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: The target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn.

heroicTraits.name: Intense Piety
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^PRIEST^^** or **^^WIZARD^^** within 18" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

heroicTraits.name: Hour of Glory
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can be picked to use the ‘Their Finest Hour’ ability even if it has already used it this battle. In addition, when this unit is picked to use the ‘Their Finest Hour’ ability, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Legendary Tenacity
heroicTraits.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

artifacts.name: Beacon of Azyr
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD^^** or **^^PRIEST^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
The next time this turn that the target uses a **^^PRAYER^^** or **^^SPELL^^** ability, instead of making a casting roll or chanting roll for them, you can use a value of 7 for the roll that cannot be modified. After that ability is resolved, if the target has any ritual points, reset their ritual points total to 0.
**Designer’s Note:** *Ritual points apply modifiers so cannot be used with this ability to increase the chanting roll to more than 7.*

artifacts.name: Sigil of Morrda
artifacts.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command or a **^^RAMPAGE^^** ability for a unit in combat with this unit
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that command or **^^RAMPAGE^^** ability has no effect, it still counts as having been used and any command points spent to use that ability are still lost.

artifacts.name: Banner of Sigmar
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Until the start of your next turn, your opponent cannot control the target objective while they have no units contesting it.

artifacts.name: Mirrorshield
artifacts.effect: This unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

artifacts.name: Quicksilver Draught
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artifacts.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Null Pendant
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Subtract 5 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Pennant of Azyrite Majesty
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target, then you can pick a friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target.
artifacts.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn, while it is visible to this unit:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the enemy target.
• Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for the friendly target.

artifacts.name: Fractured Astral Jewel
artifacts.effect: If an ability would heal or return any slain models to an enemy unit while it is within 6" of this unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

artifacts.name: Blade of the Six Smiths
artifacts.declare: Pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Halve the Attacks characteristic of the target weapon (rounding up).
• Double the Damage characteristic of the target weapon.
• Attacks made with the target weapon score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 3+.

otherEnhancements.name: Pyrotechnic Souls
otherEnhancements.effect: When this unit is destroyed, gain 3 **rage dice**.

otherEnhancements.name: Uncaged Lightning
otherEnhancements.effect: Each time an enemy unit in combat with this unit moves or is removed from the battlefield, after that ability has been resolved, if that enemy unit is on the battlefield and not in combat with this unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Veterans of Amberstone Watch
otherEnhancements.effect:
Enemy units do not have the **STRIKE-FIRST** keyword while they are in combat with this unit.
**Designer’s Note:** *Enemy units that have* **STRIKE-LAST** *would still have* **STRIKE-LAST***; they would not be treated as having neither* **STRIKE-FIRST** *nor* **STRIKE-LAST.**

battleTraits.name: Eat 'Em Alive
battleTraits.timing: End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^OGOR^^** unit that used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability that targeted a unit, excluding **^^FACTION TERRAIN^^**, this turn to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
battleTraits.effect:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target (if any). Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly **^^OGOR^^** unit for the rest of the battle. If any of these effects already apply to it, you can pick a different effect to replace the current effect.
• ***Raw and Bloody Flesh***: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that unit.
• ***Exotic Giblets***: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit’s combat attacks made with non‑**Companion** weapons.
• ***Steaming Brains***: Add 2 to that unit’s Control characteristic.
• ***Crunchy Bones***: That unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**. If that unit’s melee weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** instead.
• ***Slick Innards***: That unit can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RUN^^** ability in the same turn.
• ***Mystery Meat***: Subtract 1 from the power level of enemy units while they are in combat with that unit, to a minimum of 0.
**Designer’s Note**: *Only 1 of these effects can apply to the same unit at the same time unless specified otherwise. Also note that Steaming Brains affects the Control characteristic, not the control score.*

battleTraits.name: Bull Charge
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^OGOR MAWTRIBES^^** unit that charged this turn and has not used a **^^RAMPAGE^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Your opponent must move the target up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of your units and can end that move in combat.
After your opponent has done so, roll a dice for each model in the unit using this ability that is within 3" of the target. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability is a **^^GUTBUSTERS^^** unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
Then, the unit using this ability can make a pile-in move. If the target of this ability is still in combat with the unit using this ability, then the target of this ability must be picked as the target of the pile‑in move.
**Designer’s Note**: *Your opponent may not be able to move the models in the target unit (or may choose to leave them where they are) but the target still counts as having moved for rules purposes.*

battleTraits.name: Jaws of the Beast
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BEASTCLAW HERO^^** that is leading a regiment and that has not been deployed, then pick a non-**^^HERO^^** unit in that **^^HERO^^**'s regiment that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up those units in reserve **tracking the prey**. They have now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: Closing the Jaws
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BEASTCLAW HERO^^** that is **tracking the prey**.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that **^^HERO^^** wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other friendly unit that is **tracking the prey** wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 9" of that **^^HERO^^** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Leave Not a Morsel
heroicTraits.effect: While they are within 6" of and visible to this unit, enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them.

heroicTraits.name: Dreaded Far and Wide
heroicTraits.effect:
Ignore negative modifiers to:
• This unit’s control score.
• Hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s non‑**Companion** attacks.
• Charge rolls for this unit.
• The number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit.

heroicTraits.name: The Crusherguts
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain and the target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: A Choice Cut
artifacts.effect:
• This unit cannot use **^^RUN^^** abilities.
• Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly **^^OGOR INFANTRY^^** unit each phase while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

artifacts.name: Rusty Grater
artifacts.effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

artifacts.name: Key to the Larder
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly **^^OGOR INFANTRY^^** unit on the battlefield to be the target.
artifacts.effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

artifacts.name: Carvalox Hide
artifacts.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**. It also has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage points inflicted by **^^SPELL^^** abilities, **^^PRAYER^^** abilities and abilities used by **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^**.

artifacts.name: Mantle of Entrails
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a command, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

artifacts.name: Trophy Rack
artifacts.effect:
Pick 1 of the following trophies. For the rest of the battle, melee weapons used by other friendly **^^OGOR MAWTRIBES^^** units have the corresponding weapon ability while they are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit:
• ***Squeezed Head***: **Anti‑MONSTER (+1 Rend)**
• ***Smashed City Rubble***: **Anti‑WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**
• ***Torn Appendages***: **Anti‑CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**

otherEnhancements.name: Mage-swallower
otherEnhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Gutslugger
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks if it did not charge in the same turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Megagobbler
otherEnhancements.effect:
Pick 1 of the following keywords:
• **^^INFANTRY^^**
• **^^CAVALRY^^**
• **^^MONSTER^^**
• **^^WAR MACHINE^^**
• **^^BEAST^^**
For the rest of the battle, each time any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit with that keyword by this unit’s combat attacks and that enemy unit is destroyed in the same turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons. This effect is cumulative.

otherEnhancements.name: Extremely Obstinate
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit has a Control characteristic of 15.

otherEnhancements.name: Horn Toss
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model, that is in combat with this unit and that has charged this turn to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

otherEnhancements.name: Grumpy Alpha
otherEnhancements.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick another visible friendly **^^OGOR MONSTER^^** wholly within 12" of this unit that is not in combat to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, roll a dice. The target can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can end that move in combat. If it does so, the target has charged.

battleTraits.name: Da King's Guards
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While a friendly **^^TROGGOTH^^** unit is within the combat range of a friendly **^^HERO^^**:
• That **^^HERO^^** has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **^^HERO^^**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **^^TROGGOTH^^** unit within that **^^HERO^^**’s combat range after the damage sequence for that **^^HERO^^** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battleTraits.name: Da Loonking's Court
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-**UNIQUE KING’S GITZ HEROES** that do not have an enhancement.
battleTraits.effect:
Give each **^^HERO^^** 1 enhancement from the ‘Da King’s Gitz’ Army of Renown rules.
**Designer’s Note**: *These enhancements are given to the* **^^HEROES^^** *during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

battleTraits.name: The Moon and The Loon
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While a friendly unit is wholly within 9" of a friendly **Skragrott**, a friendly **Malevolent Moon** or a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine**:
•  Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-**^^SQUIG MOONCLAN^^** units.
•  Instead of rolling the dice to determine the Move characteristic of a friendly **^^SQUIG^^** unit, you can use a value of 4.

heroicTraits.name: Glarejester
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^INFANTRY^^** unit within 3" of this unit and that is not in combat to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a D3. Add the roll to the distance the target can move when using **^^MOVE^^** abilities this phase. If the target ends a move in this phase within 3" of this **^^HERO^^**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on this **^^HERO^^** equal to the roll.

heroicTraits.name: Da King's Adjutant
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Your Turn
heroicTraits.declare: You cannot use this ability and the **Bad Moon Loonshrine**’s ‘Moonclan Lairs’ ability in the same turn. If this unit is within 12" of a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine**, pick a friendly non-reinforced, non-**^^HERO^^**, non-**MONSTER KING’S GITZ** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine** and more than 3" from all enemy units.

artifacts.name: Wotnot of Prestige
artifacts.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit. Each visible enemy unit within 3" of that point is a target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

artifacts.name: Loonstone Medallion
artifacts.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**. While this unit is contesting an objective that is not being contested by any other friendly units, it has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

artifacts.name: Moonhoned Shiv
artifacts.effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle. In addition, each time this unit uses a **^^RETREAT^^** ability, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

battleTraits.name: Questing Tendrils
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick the terrain feature that is closest to the **quarry** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly units are wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** while they are wholly within 6" of the target.

battleTraits.name: Merciful Strike
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT MONSTER** that has not used a **^^RAMPAGE^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice and add the number of damage points the target has. If the result exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

battleTraits.name: A Prize Quarry is Sighted
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of a friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: The target becomes the **quarry** for the rest of the battle. If there was already a **quarry** on the battlefield when you declared this ability, that unit is no longer the **quarry**.

battleTraits.name: Nature Aetheric
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a terrain feature that is within friendly territory to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle, friendly units are wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** while they are wholly within 6" of the target.

battleTraits.name: Rhythm of the Chase
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: If there is no **quarry** on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: The target is the **quarry** for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Song of the Hunt
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
The following cumulative effects apply to friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** units depending on the number of **chords** you have:
**1 chord – *Simple***: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units wholly within the same quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.
**2 chords – *Tuneful***: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks that target an enemy unit wholly within the same quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.
**3-5 chords – *Melodic***: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are in combat with the quarry.
**6+ chords – *Mellifluous***: While a friendly unit is in combat with the quarry, the quarry has **STRIKE-LAST**.

battleTraits.name: Abundant Growth
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick each friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** unit that is wholly within 3" of a terrain feature to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: **Heal (1)** each target.

battleTraits.name: Opening Horn Blast
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round.
battleTraits.effect:
Your chords are reset to 0. Then, you gain 1 **chord**:
• If a friendly **Belthanos** is on the battlefield.
• For each friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** unit that is wholly within the same large quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.
• For each quarry destroyed so far during the battle.

heroicTraits.name: Sapwood Leader
heroicTraits.effect: If you pick this unit to be a target of the 'Abundant Growth’ ability, **Heal (3)** this unit instead of **Heal (1)**.

artifacts.name: Heartwood Hunting Horn
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: You gain 1 **chord**.

battleTraits.name: Notorious Bosses
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly non-**UNIQUE BIG WAAAGH! IRONJAWZ HERO** and up to 1 friendly non‑**UNIQUE BIG WAAAGH! KRULEBOYZ HERO** that do not have a heroic trait to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Give each target 1 heroic trait from the Big Waaagh! heroic traits.
**Designer’s Note**: *These heroic traits are given to the targets during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

battleTraits.name: Rally The Warclans
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: If your general is on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Big Waaagh!^^** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of your general and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: The Power of The Waaagh!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **BIG WAAAGH! IRONJAWZ** unit and up to 1 friendly **BIG WAAAGH! KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: The targets have the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: Possessed By The Power Of The Waaagh!
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While a friendly unit has the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword:
• If that unit has the **^^IRONJAWZ^^** keyword, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for that unit.
• If that unit has the **^^KRULEBOYZ^^** keyword, that unit’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

heroicTraits.name: Get Krumpin'!
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
heroicTraits.declare: You can use this ability if this unit has the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword and a friendly unit has not used a **BRUTAL KUNNIN’** ability this turn.
heroicTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Big Waaagh!^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: A Proper Sneak
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
heroicTraits.declare: You can use this ability if this unit has the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword and a friendly unit has not used a **BRUTAL KUNNIN’** ability this turn.
heroicTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle round, friendly **^^Big Waaagh!^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Takin' Names
heroicTraits.effect: If an enemy **^^HERO^^** is destroyed by this unit, this unit has the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword for the rest of the battle.

heroicTraits.name: Da Old One-Two
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
heroicTraits.declare: You can use this ability if this unit has the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword and a friendly unit has not used a **BRUTAL KUNNIN’** ability this turn.
heroicTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle round, friendly **^^Big Waaagh!^^** units’ melee weapons have **CRIT (2 HITS)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Da Sneaky Stab-slab
artifacts.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

battleTraits.name: Leave the Land in Ruin
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick a terrain feature or objective that does not have a friendly **desolation token** and is contested by a friendly **^^HELSMITHS OF HASHUT^^** unit that is not in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Give the target a **desolation token**.

battleTraits.name: Harness Daemonic Power
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Your Turn
battleTraits.effect:
You must use this ability at the start of each of your turns. Remove all **daemonic power points** from each friendly unit. Then, gain 1 **daemonic power point** for each friendly **desolation token** on the battlefield.
Then, allocate your daemonic power points to friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units. Each unit can have a maximum of 3 **daemonic power points**. Then, all unallocated **daemonic power points** are lost.
**Designer’s Note:** *Non*-**HOBGROT** *units have abilities that become more powerful depending on how many daemonic power points they have. We recommend using coloured dice to track the number of points each unit has.*

battleTraits.name: Reserves of Daemonic Power
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit that has no **daemonic power points** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Give 2 **daemonic power points** to the target.

heroicTraits.name: 'Fire, You Worms!'
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY^^** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Shoot’ ability as if it were your shooting phase. All attacks must target the same enemy unit, and the enemy unit picked to be the target of the attacks must have charged this phase. If the unmodified hit roll for any of those attacks is 1-5, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

heroicTraits.name: Servile Automaton
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^HELSMITHS OF HASHUT AUTOMATON^^** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle, the target is this unit’s bodyguard and the following effects apply:
•  While this unit is in combat and its bodyguard is within its combat range, its bodyguard has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
•  If this unit is **^^INFANTRY^^**, it has **^^Ward (5+)^^** while its bodyguard is within its combat range.

heroicTraits.name: An Eye for Weakness
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^HELSMITHS OF HASHUT^^** units that target that enemy unit.

artifacts.name: Gauntlets of Punishment
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

artifacts.name: Crucible of Spite
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: Give up to 3 **daemonic power points** to this unit. However, you cannot allocate or give any more **daemonic power points** to this unit for the rest of the battle.

artifacts.name: Scroll of Petrification
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly **^^HELSMITHS OF HASHUT^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
•  The target has **WARD (2+)**.
•  The target cannot use non-passive abilities or be picked to be the target of friendly abilities.
•  Enemy units can ignore the target’s combat range for the purposes of movement and charging.
• Enemy units can ignore the target for the purposes of setting up on the battlefield but cannot be set up on the target.

artifacts.name: Gem of Utorak
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.effect:
If this unit is not a **^^WIZARD^^**, it has **WIZARD (2)** until the start of your next turn.
If this unit is a **^^WIZARD^^**, until the start of your next turn:
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.
• Add D3 to casting rolls for this unit.

artifacts.name: Casque of Belittlement
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to each roll. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

artifacts.name: Horn of the Bullfather
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^HELSMITHS OF HASHUT^^** unit to be the target. Then, you can pick a visible friendly **Hobgrot Vandalz** unit to be a second target.
artifacts.effect: Remove each target from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

otherEnhancements.name: Breath of Contempt
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
otherEnhancements.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

otherEnhancements.name: Greed Pistons
otherEnhancements.effect: When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

otherEnhancements.name: Overdrive Switch
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an **^^ATTACK^^** ability for this unit
otherEnhancements.effect:
For the rest of the phase:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks, including those made with **Companion** weapons, that target an enemy unit within 9" of it.
• Each time an unmodified hit roll for an attack made by this unit is 1, allocate 1 damage point to this unit after the **^^ATTACK^^** ability has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

otherEnhancements.name: Infernal Motivators
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic.

otherEnhancements.name: Earthwrack Stabilisers
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it has not charged in the same turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Bullfather's Scorn
otherEnhancements.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
This unit’s ranged weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn. If each of this unit’s ranged weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, this unit’s shooting attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead.

battleTraits.name: Lethal Surprise
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **^^KRULEBOYZ^^** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
battleTraits.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, for the rest of the turn, the target’s weapons cannot be affected by the **Charge (+1 Damage)** weapon ability.

battleTraits.name: Noisy Racket
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with any friendly **^^KRULEBOYZ^^** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
battleTraits.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Venom-encrusted Weapons
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY^^** unit to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

battleTraits.name: Dirty Tricks
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: The effect of a **^^DIRTY TRICK^^** ability is only applied if you make a successful dirty trick roll. The success of a dirty trick roll depends on the number of **^^DIRTY TRICK^^** abilities your army has already used this battle round.

battleTraits.name: Sneaky Sneakin'
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY^^** unit that has 10 or fewer models, is not in combat and has not been the target of a **^^DIRTY TRICK^^** ability this turn to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
battleTraits.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Egomaniak
heroicTraits.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**^^HERO KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY^^** unit:
• This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**^^HERO KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY^^** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

heroicTraits.name: Slippery Skumbag
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, it can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

heroicTraits.name: Backstabba
heroicTraits.declare: Pick an enemy **^^HERO^^** in combat with both this unit and another friendly **^^KRULEBOYZ^^** unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted for each friendly **^^KRULEBOYZ^^** unit in combat with the target in addition to the first two **^^KRULEBOYZ^^** units.

artifacts.name: Swamp Staff
artifacts.effect: If this unit is not a **^^WIZARD^^**, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Otherwise, add 1 to this unit’s power level.

artifacts.name: Eye-biter Ash
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Mork's Eye Pebble
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
artifacts.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly **^^KRULEBOYZ^^** units have **WARD**^^ ^^**(5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Tattermask
artifacts.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, that attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

artifacts.name: Spell in a Rattle
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: This unit can use a non‐**^^SUMMON SPELL^^** ability from a spell lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 9 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound.

artifacts.name: Woggly Bogstikk
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

otherEnhancements.name: Tough 'Un
otherEnhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Sneaky 'Un
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ or ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^RETREAT^^** abilities this phase.

otherEnhancements.name: Mean 'Un
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit’s **Companion** weapons.

otherEnhancements.name: Quick 'Un
otherEnhancements.effect: Add half your **fury level** (rounding up) to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Sly 'Un
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
otherEnhancements.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

otherEnhancements.name: Spittin' 'Un
otherEnhancements.effect:
This unit is armed with the ranged weapon below, where **X** is equal to your **fury level**.
Ranged Weapon
**Caustic Saliva**
Rng: 12"
Atk: X
Hit: 4+
Wnd: 3+
Rnd: 2
Dmg: D3

battleTraits.name: Spring The Trap
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly **^^BONESPLITTERZ^^** units that charged in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Bonesplitterz Waaagh!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick each friendly **^^BONESPLITTERZ WIZARD^^** and **^^BONESPLITTERZ PRIEST^^** to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the power level of each target for the rest of the turn. In addition, friendly **^^BONESPLITTERZ^^** units have **WARD** (**5+)** for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Monster Hunters
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BONESPLITTERZ^^** unit in combat with an enemy **^^MONSTER^^** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks and add 1 to save rolls for the target.

battleTraits.name: Take Da Bait
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^BONESPLITTERZ^^** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons while it is in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn, and so long as the target has not charged during the battle.

heroicTraits.name: Killa Instinkt
heroicTraits.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.

heroicTraits.name: 'Orrible Leer
heroicTraits.effect: Enemy **^^MONSTERS^^** cannot use **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

heroicTraits.name: One Wiv Da Beast
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
heroicTraits.effect: The next time this phase that this unit uses a **^^SPELL^^** ability, instead of making a casting roll for this unit, you can use a value of 6 for the roll that cannot be modified.

artifacts.name: Glowin' Tattooz
artifacts.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.

artifacts.name: Monsta-killa Chompa
artifacts.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** while it is in combat with an enemy **^^BEAST^^** or **^^MONSTER^^**.

artifacts.name: Dokk Juice
artifacts.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Our Reach is Long
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
The **creeping overgrowth** (referenced by other abilities) extends 6" from each terrain feature that has a friendly **overgrown token**.
Increase this range by 1" for each friendly **^^LORDS OF THE CLAN^^** unit that is wholly outside friendly territory.

battleTraits.name: Dormant Heroes
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: If there are more friendly **^^LORDS OF THE CLAN^^** units on the battlefield than there are in reserve, pick a friendly **^^LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER^^** unit that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve as a **dormant forest spirit**. It has now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: Roused to Fury
battleTraits.timing: Enemy Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
