artifacts.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **^^SYLVANETH^^** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

artifacts.name: Ranu's Lamentiri
artifacts.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
artifacts.effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.

artifacts.name: Glamourweave
artifacts.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

artifacts.name: Acorn of the Ages
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** have **WARD (5+).**

artifacts.name: Dancing Mystflies
artifacts.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^SPELL^^** ability for an unit within 30" of this unit
artifacts.effect:
• If this unit is not a **^^WIZARD^^**, it can use the
'Unbind' ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
Otherwise, it can use the 'Unbind' ability an additional time each phase.
• If this unit successfully unbinds the spell being reacted to and the caster is within the **creeping overgrowth**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.

artifacts.name: Amulet of Resonance
artifacts.effect: If this unit used the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability this turn or you spent **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability when resolving the damage sequence for this unit this turn, give 1 ritual point to each visible friendly **^^SYLVANETH PRIEST^^** wholly within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Glamourweave
artifacts.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Aspect of Ironbark
otherEnhancements.effect:
When resolving the damage sequence for this unit, if you spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, you can re-roll any of the dice that determine whether damage points are removed from this unit’s damage pool.
After the damage sequence has been resolved, if you rolled a total of 10+ on those re-rolls, this ability has no effect for the rest of the battle

otherEnhancements.name: Aspect of Heartwood
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Endless Growth’ ability
otherEnhancements.effect:
If this unit is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**, for each target of that ability that is wholly within 12" of this unit, you can pick 1 of the following effects:
•  When resolving that ability, roll a D6 for the target instead of a D3. If, as a result of another ability, you would **Heal (3)** the target instead of rolling a dice, **Heal (6)** the target instead.
•  If the target is **^^KURNOTHI^^**, instead of rolling a D3 and picking 1 of the effects of that ability to apply to it, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Aspect of Harvestboon
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth.**

battleTraits.name: Rituals of Ruin
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
***Warping Curse:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of a friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO^^** or, if there is a friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO^^** in reserve, within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
***Brand of Wild Fury:*** Pick a friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS^^** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO^^** or, if there is a friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO^^** in reserve, wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has **^^Ward (6+)^^** for the rest of the turn.
***Bestial Instinct:*** Pick a friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS^^** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO^^** or, if there is a friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO^^** in reserve, wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Beastherd Ambush
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS^^** unit that is **in ambush**.
battleTraits.effect:
Set up that unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for that unit.

battleTraits.name: Masters of the Wilderness
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS^^** unit that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect:
Set up that unit in reserve **in ambush**. It has now been deployed.
**Designer’s Note:** *Any number of friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS^^** units can start the battle in reserve – even your entire Beasts of Chaos army!*

heroicTraits.name: Death-grip
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a SHOOT ability that targeted a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit
heroicTraits.effect: If that friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS^^** unit is not in combat and is wholly within 18" of this unit, after the **^^SHOOT^^** ability has been resolved, that friendly unit can move 2D6". It can move into combat.

heroicTraits.name: Bestial Cunning
heroicTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit that were set up this turn using the ‘Beastherd Ambush’ ability to be the targets.
heroicTraits.effect: Each target can immediately move D3". The targets cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

heroicTraits.name: Propagator of Ruin
heroicTraits.effect: While this unit is on the battlefield, you can use the ‘Rituals of Ruin’ ability twice per turn in your hero phase instead of once per turn. You cannot pick the same effect more than once per turn.

artifacts.name: Slitherwrack Helm
artifacts.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Gnarlstaff of Morghur
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Brayblast Trumpet
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^UNIQUE BEASTS OF CHAOS INFANTRY^^** or **^^CAVALRY^^** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Monstrous Entourage
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
The **Companion** weapon ability has no effect on **MUTATED MENAGERIE** units. While a friendly **Thanquol** is within the combat range of another friendly Mutated Menagerie unit:
• That **Thanquol** has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **Thanquol**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **MUTATED MENAGERIE** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved.

battleTraits.name: More-more Mutation!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE** unit to be the target. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per battle.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• Add 2 to the target's Health characteristic.
• Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
• The target has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
• At the end of each turn, allocate D3+2 damage points to the target.

battleTraits.name: Rampaging Demise
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit that has not used any **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect:
This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. However, at the end of the turn, this unit is destroyed. When this unit would be destroyed, before it is removed from play, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 6" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Spiteful Swarms
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit that has not used any **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect:
This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. However, at the end of the turn, this unit is destroyed. When this unit would be destroyed, before it is removed from play, roll a dice for each enemy unit within 6" of this unit. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of that enemy unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle.
After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Pack Tactics
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.
heroicTraits.effect: The targets can each use the 'All-out Attack' or 'All-out Defence' command this phase even if that command has been used by a friendly unit this phase.

artifacts.name: Warpstone Innards
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the battle. However, at the end of each turn, allocate D3 damage points to the target.

battleTraits.name: Mawpits of Ghur
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.effect:
Roll 2D6 and add the number of **tasty morsels** you have to the roll. Apply the corresponding effect below for the rest of the battle round. Then, reset your **tasty morsels** to 0.
**2-3 – *Subdued*:**
No effect.
**4-5 – *Peckish*:**
Subtract 3 from the control scores of units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits**.
**6-8 – *Rumbling*:**
Roll a dice for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.
**9-11 – *Famished*:**
Units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits** cannot use commands.
**12+ – *Ravenous*:**
Roll a D3 for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: Driven By Starvation
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Friendly **Gorger Mawpack** units can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if they used a **^^RUN^^** ability in the same turn unless they are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature.

battleTraits.name: Trampling Charge
battleTraits.timing: Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: The Realm Hungers
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Units and **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^** are **vulnerable**^^ ^^**to Mawpits** while they are on the battlefield unless they are wholly within 1" of a terrain feature that is not a **Mawpit**. This ability has no effect on **ROVING MAW** units or units that have **^^FLY^^**.

battleTraits.name: Tasty Morsels
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Each time a model is slain by a friendly **Mawpit**’s ‘Hungry Sinkhole’ ability, you gain 1 **tasty morsel**.

heroicTraits.name: Prime Gutserver
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is within 1" of a friendly **Mawpit**, gain 1 **tasty morsel**.

artifacts.name: Flasks of Congealed Maw-juices
artifacts.effect: Friendly **Mawpits** within this unit’s combat range have **WARD**^^ ^^**(5+)**.

battleTraits.name: The Crimson Keep
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP** unit that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Crimson Keep**. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units **in the Crimson Keep** than there are on the battlefield.

battleTraits.name: Blood Rampage
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP MONSTER** that is in combat and has not used any **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
This unit can make a move of 2D6". It must end that move in combat with the target unit. Then, roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Carve A Bloody Path
battleTraits.timing: Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that is in combat to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: That unit can use a **^^CHARGE^^** ability even though it is in combat and even if it has already used a **^^CHARGE^^** ability this turn.

battleTraits.name: From A Quarter Unseen
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick each friendly unit that is **in the Crimson Keep** to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Set up each target wholly within 9" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you set up any units using this ability in the third or a subsequent battle round, do not spend any command points when using the ‘Carve a Bloody Path’ command this turn.

heroicTraits.name: Immortal Dedication
heroicTraits.effect:
This unit receives D3 **martial prowess tokens**. Each **martial prowess token** can be spent to do 1 of the following:
• Re-roll a hit roll for this unit.
• Re-roll a wound roll for this unit.
• Re-roll a save roll for this unit.
At the start of the next turn, remove all this unit’s **martial prowess tokens**.

artifacts.name: Chalice of the Blood Dragon
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
artifacts.effect: **Heal (3D3)** this unit.

battleTraits.name: A Splendid Pageant
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While you believe this **^^Delusion^^**:
•  Each time a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** uses a **^^RUN^^** ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
•  While a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS INFANTRY HERO** is within the combat range of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS INFANTRY** unit that has 5 or more models, that **^^HERO^^** is not visible to enemy units more than 6" away.

battleTraits.name: Muster Guard
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^Nobles^^** to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
For each target, pick 1 of the following:
•  Return up to 3 slain models to a friendly **^^Serfs^^** unit wholly within 12" of it.
•  Return 1 slain model to a friendly **^^KNIGHTS^^** unit wholly within 12" of it.
The same unit cannot have models returned to it by this ability more than once per turn.

battleTraits.name: A Kingdom Deluded
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each turn. If it is the first turn of the battle, pick a **^^Delusion^^** from these battle traits or, unless otherwise specified, from the warscroll of a friendly unit on the battlefield. If it is not the first turn, make a delusion roll of D6.
battleTraits.effect:
On a delusion roll of 1-2, you must pick a different **^^Delusion^^** to the one you picked last turn. 
On a 3-4, you must pick the same **^^Delusion^^** as the one you picked last turn, even if it is on the warscroll of a unit that has been destroyed. In such cases, the effect of that **^^Delusion^^** applies as if the unit had not been destroyed. 
On a 5-6, you must pick a **^^Delusion^^** like you did in the first turn. For the rest of the turn, you believe the **^^Delusion^^** you picked.

battleTraits.name: Royal Blood
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^Abhorrants^^** to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: **Heal (D3)** each target.

battleTraits.name: Feeding Frenzy
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.

battleTraits.name: A Glorious Banquet
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: While you believe this **^^Delusion^^**, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES**.

battleTraits.name: Summon Loyal Subjects
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Abhorrant^^** to use this ability, then pick a friendly **^^Serfs^^** or **^^KNIGHTS^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Stronger in Madness
heroicTraits.effect:
Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.
In addition, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks that target this unit have no effect.

heroicTraits.name: Cruel Taskmaster
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO FLESH‑EATER COURTS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target.

heroicTraits.name: Savage Beyond Reason
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, if it did not use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability in the previous turn. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons instead while this unit has not used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability this battle.

artifacts.name: Charnel Vestments
artifacts.effect: If this unit is not a **^^PRIEST^^**, it has **PRIEST (1)**. If this unit is already a **^^PRIEST^^**, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit. If this unit is a **^^WIZARD^^**, it cannot use **^^SPELL^^** abilities and **^^PRAYER^^** abilities in the same phase.

artifacts.name: The Grisly Pennant
artifacts.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is greater than the target’s Control characteristic or is a 6, the following effects apply for the rest of the turn:
•  Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
•  Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that target that enemy unit.

artifacts.name: The Splintered Femur
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following:
•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
•  Subtract 1 from the target’s power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn.
•  If the target is a **^^MANIFESTATION^^**, it is banished and removed from play.

artifacts.name: Fool's Cap
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Each time the target uses a **^^CHARGE^^** ability, if possible, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of this unit.
• While the target is in combat with this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks that do not target this unit.

artifacts.name: Flayed Flags
artifacts.declare: Pick an objective you do not control within 18" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Until the start of your next turn, when resolving the damage sequence for enemy units contesting the target objective, your opponent cannot spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability.

artifacts.name: Ring of Nightmarish Visions
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. Add 1 to each roll if this unit charged this turn. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

otherEnhancements.name: Revered Monstrosity
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by other friendly non‐**UNIQUE FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTERS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Savage Abomination
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons.

otherEnhancements.name: Horribly Resilient
otherEnhancements.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit. If this unit is not a **^^HERO^^**, **Heal (2D3)** this unit instead.

otherEnhancements.name: Defenders of Chivalry
otherEnhancements.effect: While your **fury level** is 7, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

otherEnhancements.name: Loyal Squires
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **Varghulf Courtier** to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect:
For the rest of the phase:
• Add 2 to charge rolls for this unit.
• If this unit uses a **^^CHARGE^^** ability, it must end the charge move in combat with the target.

otherEnhancements.name: Homage and Fealty
otherEnhancements.declare: If this unit is a **KNIGHT**, pick a friendly **SERF** unit wholly within 12" of it to be the target. If this unit is a **SERF**, pick a friendly **KNIGHT** unit wholly within 12" of it to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to save rolls for this unit and the target while they are within 3" of and visible to each other.

battleTraits.name: The Blood Saints
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: While the friendly **Shadow Queen** is wholly within 6" of a friendly non-**HERO ZAINTHAR KAI** unit, both that **Shadow Queen** and that non-**^^HERO^^** unit have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

battleTraits.name: Cursed Heritage
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with any non-**UNIQUE ZAINTHAR KAI** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

battleTraits.name: Dark Majesty
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by a non‑**^^HERO^^** unit that targets the friendly **Morathi‑Khaine** is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

battleTraits.name: Matriarch of the Zainthar Kai
battleTraits.timing: Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick the friendly **Morathi-Khaine** to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Until the start of your next turn, this unit has a Move characteristic of 12" and has **^^FLY^^**.
• This unit can use the ‘Iron Heart of Khaine’ ability as if you had performed a blood rite.
• Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target’s attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
• Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE ZAINTHAR KAI HERO** that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 3" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Khaine's Inheritor
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

artifacts.name: Amulet of the Bladed Queen
artifacts.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.

battleTraits.name: Born of Butchery
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique^^**^^ ^^**^^Baleful Lords^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number plus the number of units (friendly and enemy) that have been destroyed this battle. If the roll contains 8 or more results of 3+, set up a replacement unit identical to the target on the battlefield, wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Drawn By Blood
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Baleful Lords^^** unit that has not used a **^^RAMPAGE^^** ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect:
That unit can move D6". It can end that move in combat but only with units it was in combat with at the start of the phase.
If that unit destroyed any enemy units this turn, then instead:
That unit can move 2D6". It can end that move in combat with any units that had any damage points allocated to them this turn.

battleTraits.name: The Price of Mercy
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability. Pick each friendly **^^Baleful Lords^^** unit that did not charge or use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability this turn to be a target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: Sunder the Sorcerous
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick each enemy **^^MANIFESTATION^^** within 3" of a friendly **^^Baleful Lords^^** unit to be a target.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll equals or exceeds the banishment value of the target:
• That target is banished and removed from play.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy unit that summoned the target.

battleTraits.name: Bellow of Hatred
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Baleful Lords^^** unit that has not used a **^^RAMPAGE^^** ability this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with the target. The target cannot use **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: First In His Sight
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
battleTraits.effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **BALEFUL LORDS HERO** that is in combat.

battleTraits.name: Mage-Eaters
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^SPELL^^** ability.
battleTraits.usedBy: A friendly **^^Baleful Lords^^** unit targeted by that **^^SPELL^^** ability.
battleTraits.effect: Make a magic-eater roll of D6. On a 3+, that spell is unbound. If the spell was unbound and the magic-eater roll was 5+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

heroicTraits.name: Unrivalled Battlelust
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly **^^Baleful Lords^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Crown of the Slaughterborn
artifacts.effect: Enemy units within 12" of this unit cannot be healed and cannot have slain models returned to them.

battleTraits.name: Arena of Slaughter
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
If the number of units (friendly or enemy) that have been destroyed this battle equals or exceeds any of the numbers below, the corresponding effect applies to friendly **^^Champions of the Arena^^** units for the rest of the battle. More than 1 effect can apply to a unit at the same time.
**1** Add 1 to run rolls for those units.
**2** Add 1 to charge rolls for those units.
**3**  Add 1 to hit rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
**4**  Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
**5**  Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those units’ melee weapons.

battleTraits.name: Frenzied Restoration
battleTraits.timing: End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **Champions of the Arena Hero** that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of a friendly **Shrine of Dark Tribute** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Let the Blood Flow
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
All effects of the ‘Arena of Slaughter’ ability apply to friendly **^^Champions of the Arena^^** units while they are wholly within **X**" of a friendly **Shrine of Dark Tribute**, where **X** is determined by the current battle round, as follows:
**Battle Round** - **X**
1 - 9"
2 - 12"
3 - 15"
4 - 18"
5 - 21"

battleTraits.name: Explosive Fury
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **Slaughter Queen** to use this ability, then pick each friendly **Blood Hags** unit on the battlefield and each visible friendly **^^Champions of the Arena^^** unit wholly within 12" of that **Slaughter Queen** to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time a target makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

heroicTraits.name: Hero of the Killing Games
heroicTraits.effect:
For the rest of the turn, while this unit is in combat with any enemy **^^HEROES^^**:
• Add 1 to the Attacks, Rend and Damage characteristics of this unit’s melee weapons.
• All of its combat attacks must target the same enemy **^^HERO^^**.

artifacts.name: Death Razor
artifacts.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^FIGHT^^** ability for this unit
artifacts.effect: After that **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by this unit’s attacks made as part of that **^^FIGHT^^** ability, you can pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Instead of making a chanting roll for the next **^^PRAYER^^** ability used by the target, you can use a value of 10 for the roll that cannot be modified, even if this unit has been destroyed.

battleTraits.name: Legendary Vandals
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ** units have **Anti‑FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend)** and **Anti‑WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**.

battleTraits.name: Ironclad Scrums
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ**^^ ^^**Ardboyz** units with 3 or more models have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of a different friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ**^^ ^^**Ardboyz** unit with 3 or more models.

battleTraits.name: Into Da Breach!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ** unit that is more than 9" from any enemy units and had any damage points allocated to it this turn.
battleTraits.effect: That unit can move D6". It cannot pass through the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end that move in combat.

battleTraits.name: Shield of Scrap and Muscle
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While a friendly **Zoggrok Anvilsmasha** is within the combat range of a friendly **Ardboyz** unit:
• That **Zoggrok Anvilsmasha** has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **Zoggrok Anvilsmasha**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Ardboyz** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

heroicTraits.name: Oi! Back To It!
heroicTraits.effect: If a friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ Ardboyz** or **^^Brutes^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

artifacts.name: Da Great Wollopa
artifacts.effect:
If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made by this unit, that enemy unit is **krump’d** until the start of your next turn.
While a unit is **krump’d**:
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for that unit.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for that unit.

battleTraits.name: Broken Slumber
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** unit that is a **living**^^ ^^**landmark**.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Living Landmark
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** unit that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve as a **living landmark**. It has now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: Moon-toughened Hide
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: In battle rounds 2 and 3, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** units.

battleTraits.name: Herd Healing
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly **^^TROGGOTH^^** unit uses a **^^FIGHT^^** ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** that unit.

battleTraits.name: Aura of Haywire Magic
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: The effects of a friendly **Trugg**’s ‘Malfunctioning Leystone’ ability affect friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** units anywhere on the battlefield instead of only those wholly within 12" of that friendly **Trugg**.

heroicTraits.name: Loonstone Teef
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^FIGHT^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Crunchy Shinies
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
artifacts.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3 to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.

battleTraits.name: Secure Investments
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^Code^^** abilities this turn and if any enemy units that were within 3" of your **Zontari Endrin Dock** this turn were destroyed this turn.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target friendly non-**INFANTRY PIONEER** units or friendly faction terrain features.

battleTraits.name: Market Dominance
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^Code^^** abilities this turn and if you control every objective that is not wholly within enemy territory.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle, each time you use your **Zontari Endrin Dock**’s ‘Endrinworks Outpost’ ability, you can set up a replacement **^^Auto-Endrin^^** on a manufacturing roll of 3+ instead of 4+.

battleTraits.name: Aggressive Acquisitions
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^Code^^** abilities this turn and if there is a friendly **PIONEER** unit in each large quarter of the battlefield. Each of those units must be more than 6" from all other large quarters of the battlefield and not in combat.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle, enemy units cannot be set up within your territory or within 9" of an objective that you control.

battleTraits.name: Initial Investment
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: Each friendly **^^Auto-Endrin^^** can move 2D6" but cannot finish that move in combat.

battleTraits.name: Settling Accounts
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^Code^^** abilities this turn and if a friendly **^^Auto-Endrin^^** was destroyed this turn by an enemy unit.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle, each time a friendly **^^Auto-Endrin^^** is removed from the battlefield, before removing it, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of that **^^Auto-Endrin^^**.

battleTraits.name: Hostile Takeover
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^Code^^** abilities this turn and if an enemy **^^HERO^^** was destroyed by shooting attacks made by a friendly **PIONEER** unit this turn.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **PIONEER** units or friendly faction terrain features.

heroicTraits.name: Copper Fingers
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Endrinworks Outpost’ ability for a Zontari Endrin Dock
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is wholly within 9" of that **Zontari Endrin Dock**, instead of resolving the effect of the ‘Endrinworks Outpost’ ability, set up a replacement **^^Auto-Endrin^^** on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **Zontari Endrin Dock** and more than 3" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Territorial Trailblazer
heroicTraits.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

artifacts.name: Thorgsson's Universal Automaton Actuator
artifacts.effect: Add 6" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Auto-Endrins^^** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Rockbuster Charges
artifacts.declare: Pick a terrain feature that this unit passed across this turn. Each enemy unit within 1" of that terrain feature is a target.
artifacts.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

battleTraits.name: Pitiless Reapers
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that passed across any enemy units this phase to use this ability, then pick 1 of those enemy units to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that passed across the target. Add 1 to the roll if any friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION Black Coaches** passed across the target this phase. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: Spectral Swiftness
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that is in combat to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.

battleTraits.name: Ethereal
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT^^** units.

battleTraits.name: The Speed of Death
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that used a **^^CHARGE^^** or **^^RETREAT^^** ability this turn, is not in combat and is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Silent Overseer
heroicTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
heroicTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the targets can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if they used a **^^RETREAT^^** ability in the same turn.

artifacts.name: Talisman of the Nadir
artifacts.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
artifacts.effect: If a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, this unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had **WIZARD (1).** Add 1 to the unbinding roll for that ability.

battleTraits.name: Too Quick To Hit-hit
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** and **^^CAVALRY^^** units by **^^RETREAT^^** abilities.

battleTraits.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER SKAVEN** unit that is not in combat and was not set up this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

battleTraits.name: Splinters of the Vermindoom
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: You can use this ability if there are fewer than 3 friendly **Gnawholes** on the battlefield.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a **Gnawhole** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

battleTraits.name: The Lurking Vermintide
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the tunnels below**. It has now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: Gnawhole Ambush
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit that is **in the**^^ ^^**tunnels below** to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Gnawhole** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Skilled Manipulator
heroicTraits.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit:
• This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

heroicTraits.name: Scurry Away
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

heroicTraits.name: Short-tempered
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **^^Skaven^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Pit Tinkerer
heroicTraits.effect: You can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for the Move characteristic of friendly **SKRYRE WAR MACHINES** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. In addition, each time a friendly **SKRYRE WAR MACHINE** wholly within 18" of this unit uses the ‘Rolling Doom’ or ‘Whirling Doom’ ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any.

heroicTraits.name: Devious Underling
heroicTraits.declare: Pick another friendly **SKAVEN HERO** on the battlefield with a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit’s Health characteristic to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• While the target has not been slain, friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
• Once the target has been slain, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Fleshmeddler
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Moulder^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Masterclan Connections
heroicTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^SPELL^^** or **^^UNBIND^^** ability for a visible **^^Skaven^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit
heroicTraits.effect: Add D3 to that casting roll or unbinding roll.

heroicTraits.name: Master of the Swarm
heroicTraits.effect: Each time an ability returns 1 or more slain models to a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

heroicTraits.name: Essence of the Gnaw
heroicTraits.declare: Pick another visible friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit and in combat to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** and the target has **STRIKE-LAST**.

artifacts.name: Skavenbrew
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Foulhide
artifacts.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

artifacts.name: Warpstone Charm
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Serrated Bone Protrusions
otherEnhancements.effect: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by an enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

otherEnhancements.name: Anabolic Accelerators
otherEnhancements.effect: If this unit was set up this turn, when making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

otherEnhancements.name: Transplanted Brains
otherEnhancements.effect:
Pick 1 of the following brains. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn:
***Warpstone Addict’s Brain***:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
• This unit has a maximum control score of 1.
***Warlock Whelp’s Brain***: Add 10 to this unit’s control score.

battleTraits.name: Timberrrrr!
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit or **^^LITTLE^^** unit model is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

battleTraits.name: The World Titan's Prophet
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While any other friendly **BRODD’S STOMP** units are within a friendly **King Brodd**’s combat range:
• That friendly **King Brodd** has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly **King Brodd**, allocate 1 damage point to another friendly **BRODD’S STOMP** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence for that friendly **King Brodd** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battleTraits.name: Wrath of Brodd
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit that has not used a **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: If the unit using this ability charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit can move 3D6" but must end that move in combat. When it does so, it can pass through terrain features and enemy models as if it had **^^FLY^^**.’

battleTraits.name: Double Stomp
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit that has not used a **DESTRUCTVE IMPULSE** ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add the result to the Attacks characteristic of the **Almighty Stomp** of the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: Crafty Creepers
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit that has not used a **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy **^^HERO^^** that has an artefact of power and is in combat with that **^^BIG^^** unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.

battleTraits.name: Smash It All To Bits
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit that has not used a **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick a terrain feature within its combat range. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of that **^^BIG^^** unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each friendly and enemy unit on the terrain feature that was picked. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. After rolling for all those units, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: Watch This!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit that has not used a **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
If the target is a **^^HERO^^**, **^^BEAST^^**, **^^MONSTER^^** or **^^WAR MACHINE^^**, roll 6 dice. Otherwise, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each roll that is equal to or greater than the target’s Save characteristic, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
The **^^BIG^^** unit using this **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: I Can Do That Better
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability for a friendly unit
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can use the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability immediately after the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability used by the other friendly unit has been resolved. This unit can do so even if it has used another **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn.

artifacts.name: Lucky Shiny Hat
artifacts.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage points inflicted by **^^SPELL^^** and **^^PRAYER^^** abilities and by abilities used by **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^**.

battleTraits.name: Puppet on a String
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy **^^HERO^^** within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE-CULT HERO** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a **^^CORE^^** ability, gain 1 **fate point**.
**Designer’s Note:** *You can only gain fate points using this ability and the ‘Spell-eater Pendant’ ability.*

battleTraits.name: Illusory Infiltration
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-reinforced **CHANGE-CULT KAIRIC ACOLYTES** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and not in combat.

battleTraits.name: Overtaken by Events
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Spend 1 **fate point**. Then, pick an enemy unit within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE‑CULT HERO** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Seeds of Discord
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Spend 1 **fate point**. Then, pick an enemy model within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE-CULT HERO** to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target’s combat range to be the victim.
battleTraits.effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target made with that weapon against the victim.

battleTraits.name: Silver Simulacrum
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.effect:
If there is a friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional **Argent Shard** on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.
**Designer’s Note:** *The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

heroicTraits.name: Call of Anarchy
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 18" of this unit, then pick a friendly non-**HERO CHANGE-CULT** unit that is **masked by illusion** or that has been destroyed to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
If you picked a unit that is **masked by illusion**, set it up wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.
If you picked a unit that has been destroyed, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.
**Designer’s Note:** *Units can be set up in reserve masked by illusion using the Fatemaster’s ‘Long in the Planning’ ability.*

artifacts.name: Spell-Eater Pendant
artifacts.effect: Each time this unit unbinds a spell or banishes an enemy **^^MANIFESTATION^^**, gain 1 **fate point**.

battleTraits.name: Speed of the Blood Crow
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **^^OATH^^** ability this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, the target can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RUN^^** ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Hunger of Shesh'shan
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **^^OATH^^** ability this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

battleTraits.name: Rage of Arkhar
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **^^OATH^^** ability this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 2 **oath points**. The target can use 2 **^^FIGHT^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Daemonfire Weapons
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **^^OATH^^** ability this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

battleTraits.name: Shroud of the Pale Elk
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
battleTraits.usedBy: A friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit targeted by that **^^ATTACK^^** ability, if you have 1 or more **oath points**.
battleTraits.effect: If that friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit has not used an **^^OATH^^** ability this turn, spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, that friendly unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.

battleTraits.name: Messengers of the Gods
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS Darkoath Marauders** or **Fellriders** unit that has been destroyed and has not used an **^^OATH^^** ability this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 2 **oath points**. Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Pledges to the Dark Gods
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
Each time a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit uses 1 of the following abilities and the effect of that ability is resolved, gain 1 **oath point**.
• ‘Oath of Bloodshed’
• ‘Oath of Murder’
• ‘Oath of Supremacy’
• ‘Oath of the Marauder’
• ‘Oath of the Raider’
• ‘Oath of Conquest’
**Designer’s Note**: *The abilities listed above are abilities on* **^^DARKOATH^^** *warscrolls. By using those abilities (i.e. completing the oaths), the player gains* **oath points**, *which can then be spent to use the* **^^OATH^^** *abilities in these Army of Renown rules.*

heroicTraits.name: Oath of Kinship
heroicTraits.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of another friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks.

artifacts.name: Grand Offering
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Movement Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS Wilderfiend** within 9" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Give the target D6 **sacrifice points**.

battleTraits.name: The Ritual Dance
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: In the third battle round, while a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit is in combat with an enemy unit that contains any champions, musicians or standard bearers, it can move 6" instead of 3" when it makes a pile-in move.

battleTraits.name: A Display of Falconry
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability in the second battle round. Pick each enemy unit that used a **^^CHARGE^^** ability this phase to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: Eat Your Fill!
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
In the fourth battle round, each time a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit uses a **^^FIGHT^^** ability, after that ability has been resolved:
• If that unit is damaged, **Heal (D3)** that unit.
•  If that unit is not damaged, return up to 3 slain models to it.

battleTraits.name: The Equinox Parade
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
In the first battle round:
•  Add 1 to run rolls for friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units for each other friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit that has used a **^^RUN^^** ability this phase.
•  Add D6" to the distance friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units can move when they use a **^^RETREAT^^** ability.

battleTraits.name: Make Merry 'Til the Morn
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: In the fifth battle round, friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units have **^^Ward (4+)^^** while they are within 3" of 2 or more other visible friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units.

heroicTraits.name: Lord of Revelries
heroicTraits.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

artifacts.name: Broken Sceptre of the Solstice
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit that has been destroyed to be the target. This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed, but if it does, this unit must be the target.
artifacts.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Depict Rune
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following runes to depict on your **battle scripture**. The effect and conditional enhanced effects of that rune last for the rest of the battle round. Each rune remains on your **battle scripture** for the rest of the battle or until it is removed or replaced by another ability.
**Varinor, Rune of Strength:** Pick up to 2 friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS^^** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for each target. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 1 to wound rolls for each target’s combat attacks.
• While **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, each target can use **^^SHOOT^^** and/or **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RETREAT^^** ability in the same turn.
**Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS^^** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Each target has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Varinor, Rune of Strength** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, the targets’ melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
• While **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets.
**Ydriliqi, Rune of the River**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS^^** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of any of the targets. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by the targets.
• If **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, each target can immediately move up to 3". They can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
**Oreali, Rune of the Wind**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS^^** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Varinor, Rune of Strength** is depicted on your battle scripture, add 4" to each target’s Move characteristic.
• While **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 5 to each target’s control score.
**Thalari, Rune of the Zenith**: Add 2 to casting rolls for friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS^^** units. In addition, if you have 4 or more unique runes depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 4" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS^^** units and friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS^^** units’ attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
**Designer’s Note:** *We recommend noting the runes you have inscribed in each battle round on a piece of paper to keep track of which are currently depicted on your **battle scripture.** Feel free to note them by type (Strength, River, Mountain etc.), by initial (each has a different first letter) or, if you are feeling particularly adventurous, you can try your hand at aelven calligraphy and learn to draw each rune!*

heroicTraits.name: Flawless Commander
heroicTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS INFANTRY^^** units wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
heroicTraits.effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

heroicTraits.name: Masterful Tactician
heroicTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a visible friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
heroicTraits.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

heroicTraits.name: Acolyte of the Runes
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS HERO^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: That **^^HERO^^** can be picked as an additional target the next time you use the ‘Depict Rune’ ability.

heroicTraits.name: Aetherquartz Requisitioner
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD within this unit’s combat range
heroicTraits.effect: Add 3 to the casting roll for that spell.

heroicTraits.name: Martial Perfectionist
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is damaged or that had any models slain this turn to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS INFANTRY^^** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Flawless Commander
heroicTraits.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS INFANTRY^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Scholar of the Sigils
heroicTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following runes and apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the battle. That rune cannot be depicted on your battle scripture for the rest of the battle.
***Varinor, Rune of Strength***: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.
***Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain***: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
***Ydriliqi, Rune of the River***: This unit’s melee weapons have **Anti-charge**^^ ^^**(+1 Rend)** and this unit’s ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat**.
***Oreali, Rune of the Wind***: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target this unit.
***Thalari, Rune of the Zenith***: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Peerless Swordsman
heroicTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit with a starting size of 1 that is in combat with this unit to be the target, then pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons to be the **parrying blade**.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the Attacks characteristic of the **parrying blade**. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s non‐**Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, for each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

heroicTraits.name: Dispassionate Soul
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is in combat with an enemy **^^HERO^^**, reduce your opponent’s **fury level** by **X**, where **X** is the number of unique runes depicted on your battle scripture.

artifacts.name: Phoenix Stone
artifacts.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

artifacts.name: Silver Wand
artifacts.effect: If this unit is not a **^^WIZARD^^**, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Otherwise, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

artifacts.name: Waystone
artifacts.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.

otherEnhancements.name: Perfect Footwork
otherEnhancements.effect: If each model in this unit is contesting the same objective, this unit can move up to 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of the move. It does not have to end that move in combat. It must end that move with each of its models contesting the same objective. Then, this unit cannot use **^^RUN^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Patient Strike
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that is in combat with the target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

otherEnhancements.name: Dazzling Phalanx
otherEnhancements.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^CHARGE^^** ability for a unit within 9" of and visible to this unit
otherEnhancements.effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target the enemy unit using that **^^CHARGE^^** ability.

battleTraits.name: Under the Light of the Bad Moon
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
During the battle, the effects below apply to friendly **^^GLOOMSPITE GITZ^^** units based on the current face of the Bad Moon:
***Frothing Zealots***: While the Bad Moon is **Cacklin’** or **Grinnin’**, add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-**^^SQUIG^^**^^ ^^**^^MOONCLAN^^** units.
***Spiderfang Venom***: While the Bad Moon is **Cacklin’** or **Grinnin’**, combat attacks made by friendly **^^SPIDERFANG^^** units score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+. This also affects **Companion** weapons.
***Moonlit Hide***: While the Bad Moon is **Grinnin’** or **Scowlin’**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target friendly **^^TROGGOTH^^** units.
***Lunar Squigs***: While the Bad Moon is **Scowlin’** or **Sulkin’**, instead of rolling the dice to determine the Move characteristic of a friendly **^^SQUIG^^** unit, you can use a value of 4.
***Sneaky Snarlfangs***: While the Bad Moon is **Sulkin’** or **Cacklin’**, friendly **^^GITMOB^^** units can use **^^CHARGE^^** and **^^SHOOT^^** abilities even if they used a **^^RETREAT^^** ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: The Faces of the Bad Moon
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round. If multiple players are commanding a Gloomspite Gitz army, then instead, at the start of the battle round, those players roll off and only the winner declares and uses this ability this battle round.
battleTraits.effect: If it is the first battle round, pick the starting face of the Bad Moon (**Grinnin’**, **Scowlin’**, **Sulkin’** or **Cacklin’**). If it is not the first battle round, the face of the Bad Moon moves to the next face in the sequence.

battleTraits.name: Creeping Gloom
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a terrain feature to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while friendly non-**^^MONSTER^^** non-**^^WAR MACHINE GLOOMSPITE GITZ^^** units are wholly within 3" of that terrain feature, they are not visible to enemy units more than 9" away.

heroicTraits.name: Fight Another Day
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

heroicTraits.name: Loontouched
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is not a **^^WIZARD^^**, it has **WIZARD (1)**. Otherwise, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

heroicTraits.name: The Clammy Hand
heroicTraits.effect: Each time a friendly **^^GLOOMSPITE GITZ^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

artifacts.name: Leering Gitshield
artifacts.effect: Each time an unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^ATTACK^^** ability has been resolved.

artifacts.name: The Clammy Cowl
artifacts.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

artifacts.name: Backstabber's Blade
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy **^^HERO^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

otherEnhancements.name: Spoofshrooms
otherEnhancements.effect: Roll a dice. If this unit is **^^GITMOB^^**, roll D3+3 instead. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

otherEnhancements.name: Fizzcap
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit can use a **^^SUMMON SPELL^^** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 12 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound. Then, if this unit is not **^^MOONCLAN^^**, roll a dice. On a 1-4, 1 model in this unit is automatically slain.

otherEnhancements.name: Glitzy Bitz Rolla
otherEnhancements.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
If this unit is a non-**^^TROGGOTH^^** unit, add 1 to wound rolls for its attacks for the rest of the turn.
If this unit is a **^^TROGGOTH^^**, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Set the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Colossal Boulder Club** to 6.
• Set the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Throwin’ Boulders** to 3.
• Set the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Noxious Vomit** to 3.

battleTraits.name: Reckless Abandon

battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^WARPSHATTER THROES^^** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' melee weapons.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target those friendly units.

battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While a friendly **Vizzik Skour** is within the combat range of another friendly **GNAWHORDE** Unit:
• That **Vizzik Skour** has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **Vizzik**^^ ^^**Skour**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **GNAWHORDE** Unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved.

battleTraits.name: Frenzied Momentum
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^WARPSHATTER THROES^^** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 2 to run rolls and charge rolls for the targets.
• Subtract 1 from the targets' control scores.

battleTraits.name: Unstoppable Warp-volley
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^WARPSHATTER THROES^^** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets' ranged weapons.
• The targets cannot use commands.

heroicTraits.name: Harbinger of the Great Ascendancy
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is not in combat, you can use 2 different **^^WARPSHATTER THROES^^** abilities this turn instead of 1.

artifacts.name: Icon of Great-total Supremacy
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: You can return up to D3 slain models to each friendly **GNAWHORDE INFANTRY** unit with a Health characteristic of up to 3.

battleTraits.name: Rearing Strike
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER** that has not used a **^^RAMPAGE^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll 2 dice. Add 2 to each roll if the target is a **^^MONSTER^^**. For each 5+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: Daring Tamers
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Enemy **^^MONSTERS^^** have **STRIKE-LAST** while they are in combat with 2 or more friendly **DROTHKEEPERS Vulkyn Flameseekers** units.

battleTraits.name: Skilled Drothwranglers
battleTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly MAGMADROTH
battleTraits.effect:
Pick a friendly **Vulkyn Flameseekers** unit and/or a friendly **DROTHKEEPERS INFANTRY HERO** that are not in combat and are wholly within 6" of the **^^MAGMADROTH^^** to be the targets. Units that have **hitched a lift** this turn (see below) cannot be targets.
Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the **^^MAGMADROTH^^** ends its move, you must set up each target on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of the **^^MAGMADROTH^^** and not in combat. The targets have **hitched a lift**. Units that **hitched a lift** cannot use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Searing Claws

battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target that enemy unit.

battleTraits.name: Ferocious Heat
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER** that has not used a **^^RAMPAGE^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Raised Around Beasts
heroicTraits.effect: The melee weapons of friendly non-**^^MONSTER^^** units have **Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within 9" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Mastery Over Monsters
artifacts.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective, enemy **^^MONSTERS^^** contesting that objective each have a maximum control score of 2.

battleTraits.name: Masterful Daemonworks
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST WAR MACHINES** have **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

battleTraits.name: Rising Fire

battleTraits.effect:
