***Daemonic Weaponry:*** Those units’ weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
**Battle Round 3:**
***Harnessed Sorcery:*** Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for those units.
**Battle Round 4:**
***Channelled Power:*** Attacks made by those units score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
**Battle Round 5:**
***Arcane Dominance:*** Add 1 to the power level of those units if they are a **^^WIZARD^^** or **^^PRIEST^^**.

battleTraits.name: Dread Ranks Unbroken

battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO GRAND FORGEHOST INFANTRY** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up), wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Ruthless Overseer
heroicTraits.effect: Each time a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

artifacts.name: Talisman of Obsidian
artifacts.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

battleTraits.name: Pitiless Assault
battleTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^FIGHT^^** ability for a unit that has not used a **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** ability this phase
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **^^relentless discipline^^** point. Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made as part of that **^^FIGHT^^** ability.

battleTraits.name: Immortal Elite
battleTraits.timing: Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HEROES^^** on the battlefield. Pick a friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO^^** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: You gain a number of **^^relentless discipline^^** points equal to the number after the target's **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent **^^relentless discipline^^** points are lost.

battleTraits.name: Ruthless Extermination

battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **^^relentless discipline^^** point. Subtract l from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **^^SHOOT^^** ability.

battleTraits.name: Impassive Retreat
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS^^** unit that has not used a **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** ability this phase to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **^^relentless discipline^^** point. For the rest of the turn, that unit can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RETREAT^^** ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Remorseless March
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS^^** unit that has not used a **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** ability this phase to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **^^relentless discipline^^** point. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of that unit for the rest of the phase. That unit cannot use **^^RUN^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Inviolate Legions
battleTraits.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an **^^ATTACK^^** ability
battleTraits.usedBy: A friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS^^** unit targeted by that **^^ATTACK^^** ability. Friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS^^** units can use this ability more than once per phase.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **^^relentless discipline^^** point. That unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** against damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **^^ATTACK^^** ability.

heroicTraits.name: Manufactured Mind
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Battle Round
heroicTraits.effect: When picking a friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO^^** to be the target of the 'Immortal Elite' ability this battle round, you can pick a friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO^^** that has been destroyed.

heroicTraits.name: Immaculate Defender
heroicTraits.effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY^^** unit in the combat phase while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Imperious Will
heroicTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^FIGHT^^** ability for a non-**^^HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
heroicTraits.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with that non-**^^HERO^^** unit and that did not charge this turn to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **^^FIGHT^^** ability.

artifacts.name: Amulet of Gnosis
artifacts.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **OSSIARCH B0NEREAPERS** units by **^^RETREAT^^** abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Shard of Necris
artifacts.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4 and this unit did not charge in the same turn, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

artifacts.name: Blade of the Nadir
artifacts.effect: Pick 1 of this unit's non-**Companion** melee weapons. For the rest of the battle, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made with that weapon, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

artifacts.name: Banner of Old Ossia
artifacts.timing: Reaction: You declared the ‘Rally’ command for a visible **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
artifacts.effect:
When resolving that command, you can spend rally points in the following additional ways:
•  For each rally point spent, **Heal (1)** another visible friendly non-**^^HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
•  You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to a visible friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Scarabaean Cloak
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
artifacts.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

artifacts.name: Soulweb Gem
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
artifacts.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it was destroyed this turn.
artifacts.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to this unit on the battlefield wholly within friendly territory and not in combat. Then, allocate a number of damage points to the replacement unit equal to its Health characteristic minus 1 (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

otherEnhancements.name: Perpetually Empowered Weapons
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

otherEnhancements.name: Elongated Tibias
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Utterly Unquestioning
otherEnhancements.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 5+, subtract 1 from the number of **^^relentless discipline^^** points that must be spent to use that ability.

battleTraits.name: Blood-smeared Hooves
battleTraits.timing: Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that charged this turn and has not used a **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** ability this phase to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **^^relentless discipline^^** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **^^relentless discipline^^** points instead. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's weapons, including **Companion** weapons, for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Fury of Zandtos
battleTraits.timing: Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that charged this turn and that has not used a **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** ability this phase to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **^^relentless discipline^^** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **^^relentless discipline^^** points instead. The target's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Vengeful Outriders
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that has not used a **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** ability this phase to be the target
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **^^relentless discipline^^** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **^^relentless discipline^^** points instead. Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the phase.

battleTraits.name: Praetorian Elite
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA HEROES** on the battlefield. Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA HERO** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: You gain a number of **^^relentless discipline^^** points equal to the number shown after the target's **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent **^^relentless discipline^^** points are lost.

battleTraits.name: Silent Menace
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that has not used a **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** ability this phase to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 **^^relentless discipline^^** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **^^relentless discipline^^** points instead. The target cannot use the 'Redeploy' command for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Kavalos Lance
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: When a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit uses the 'Power Through' command, the target does not have to have a lower Health characteristic than that friendly unit.

heroicTraits.name: Prevailing Tactician
heroicTraits.effect: If a friendly **Arch-Kavalos Zandtos** is not wholly within 12" of this unit, you gain 2 **^^relentless discipline^^** points.

artifacts.name: Helm of Tyranny
artifacts.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

battleTraits.name: Thunderous Roar
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^DRACONITH SKYWING MONSTER^^** that has not used any **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with it to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 5 from that target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Aetheric Cyclone
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^DRACONITH SKYWING MONSTER^^** that has not used any **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Exemplars of Fury
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **^^DRACONITH SKYWING HEROES^^** while they are within 6" of 2 or more friendly **Stormdrake Guard** units.

battleTraits.name: Shields of the Warden
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While any friendly **Stormdrake Guard** units are within a friendly **Ionus Cryptborn**’s combat range:
• That friendly **Ionus Cryptborn** has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly **Ionus Cryptborn**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Stormdrake Guard** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence for that friendly **Ionus Cryptborn** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

heroicTraits.name: Fearless Fliers
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can immediately make a D6" move and can end that move in combat.

artifacts.name: Celestium Ensign
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
artifacts.effect: **Heal (3)** each friendly **^^DRACONITH SKYWING^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

battleTraits.name: Quetzl the Preserver
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons for attacks that target friendly **^^SERAPHON^^** units that are wholly within friendly territory.

battleTraits.name: Tepok the Seer
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^SERAPHON^^** units.

battleTraits.name: Sotek the Deliverer
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 2 to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^SERAPHON^^** units.

battleTraits.name: Itzl the Tamer
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **^^SERAPHON^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

battleTraits.name: The Great Plan
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability. Pick an **^^ASTERISM^^** ability to be prophesied.
battleTraits.effect: That **^^ASTERISM^^** ability can be used for the rest of the battle, but the others cannot, unless prophesied by the ‘Further the Great Plan’ ability.

battleTraits.name: Further the Great Plan
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare:
You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick an **^^ASTERISM^^** that you have prophesied. You cannot pick an **^^ASTERISM^^** that you have previously picked this battle. If you do not meet the condition below that corresponds to that Asterism, this ability has no effect.
***Itzl the Tamer:*** 3 or more enemy units have been destroyed.
***Quetzl the Preserver:*** There are no enemy units wholly within friendly territory.
***Sotek the Deliverer:*** The enemy general is in combat or has been destroyed.
***Tepok the Seer:*** There are any friendly **^^SLANN^^** units on the battlefield and no friendly **^^SLANN^^** units are in combat or have been destroyed.
battleTraits.effect: Pick an **^^ASTERISM^^** ability to be prophesied. Its effects apply in addition to those of all other prophesied **^^ASTERISM^^** abilities.

heroicTraits.name: Child of the Stars
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

heroicTraits.name: Chosen of Quetzl
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**^^MONSTER SKINK^^** unit that is in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can move up to 8". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

heroicTraits.name: Keeper of the Old Ways
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the ‘Further the Great Plan’ ability
heroicTraits.effect: You can pick 2 different **^^ASTERISM^^** abilities instead of 1. They are both used in addition to the one you picked in the deployment phase.

heroicTraits.name: Beastmaster
heroicTraits.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^SERAPHON CAVALRY^^** and **^^SERAPHON MONSTER^^** units for the rest of the phase if they are wholly within 12" of this unit at the start of the move.

heroicTraits.name: Reptilian Cunning
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit charged this turn, if a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘All-out Attack’ command in the combat phase, no command points are spent.

heroicTraits.name: Being of the Stars
heroicTraits.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).

heroicTraits.name: Arcane Determination
heroicTraits.effect: Add 10 to this unit’s control score while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^MANIFESTATION^^**.

heroicTraits.name: Calm and Collected
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
heroicTraits.effect: Reduce your and your opponent’s **fury levels** by up to 3, to a minimum of 0. You must reduce both players’ **fury levels** by the same amount.

heroicTraits.name: Lord of Space and Time
heroicTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^SERAPHON^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit that have not used a **^^MOVE^^** ability this turn to be the targets.
heroicTraits.effect:
This unit gains a number of **stored time points** equal to the number of targets picked. 
Then, if this unit has 5 or more **stored time points**, you can pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 18" of it. In your opponent’s next turn, halve the Move characteristic of those enemy units. If you do so, this unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

artifacts.name: Bloodrage Pendant
artifacts.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons. Add 2 instead if the number of damage points allocated to this unit is equal to or greater than half of this unit’s Health characteristic (rounding up).

artifacts.name: Incandescent Rectrices
artifacts.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

artifacts.name: Coatl Familiar
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD within this unit’s combat range
artifacts.effect: Add D6 to the casting roll for that spell.

otherEnhancements.name: Armour Cruncher
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Ancient Defender
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit’s **Companion** weapons.

otherEnhancements.name: Titan of the Land
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit counts as a terrain piece for the purpose of picking targets for the friendly **Realmshaper Engine**’s ‘Power Unleashed’ ability. Do not inflict any mortal damage on this unit as part of that ability.

otherEnhancements.name: Titanic Slam
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Armour Cruncher
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, apply the effect below.
Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Chameleonic Camouflage
otherEnhancements.effect: While this unit has not used a **^^MOVE^^** ability in the same turn, it is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away.

battleTraits.name: Hate-fuelled Killers
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: The first time each friendly **^^GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS^^** unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 5+, that unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** that unit.

battleTraits.name: Brutal Lashmaster
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly **Bloodstoker** uses the 'Whipped to Fury' ability, another friendly **^^GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO^^** within its combat range can be picked to be the target of that ability instead of a non-**^^HERO BLOODBOUND^^** unit.

battleTraits.name: Legendary Slayers
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: **Blood-hungry** weapons used by friendly **^^GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS^^** units have **Crit (Mortal)**.

battleTraits.name: The Red God's Eye
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Friendly **^^GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

battleTraits.name: Murder-won Trophies
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO^^** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Give the target 1 artefact of power from the 'Gorechosen Champions' Army of Renown rules.
**Designer's Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the **^^HERO^^** during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

heroicTraits.name: Crowned in Butchery
heroicTraits.effect: Add 20 to this unit's control score while it is in combat.

artifacts.name: The Scarring Blade
artifacts.effect:
Allocate D3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add **X** to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS^^** units for the rest of the turn, where **X** is equal to the number of damage points allocated to this unit this turn by this ability.
For the rest of the battle, this unit cannot use the ‘Hate-fuelled Killers’ ability and cannot be healed.

artifacts.name: Warmonger's Icon
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick this unit and up to D3 friendly **^^GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS^^** units within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
artifacts.effect: The targets have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Bloodmist Skull
artifacts.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (3+)^^** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.

battleTraits.name: The Summerking's Colours
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** unit that contains any standard bearers to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
•  While the target unit contains any standard bearers, add 10 to the control scores of friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** units while they are wholly within 24" of the target.
•  Once all of the standard bearers in the target unit have been slain, subtract 5 from the control scores of friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** units.

battleTraits.name: A Duel, Good Sir!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability if the friendly **Ushoran** is in combat with the enemy general. Pick the enemy general to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse Ushoran’s challenge.
***Accept***: For the rest of the turn, when the friendly **Ushoran** and the target are picked to use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability, all of their attacks must target each other.
***Refuse***: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Red Errantry Hosts
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^KNIGHTS^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: The Knight's Vow
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick each friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** unit that did not charge this turn to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Start rolling dice, one at a time and one for each target, and stop when you roll a 6. The target you rolled a 6 for can use 2 **^^FIGHT^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn. If you rolled for each target and did not roll a 6, this ability has no effect.

battleTraits.name: In Their Sire's Shadow
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: If the friendly **Ushoran** is not in combat and has not used any **^^RUN^^** or **^^RETREAT^^** abilities this turn, pick him to use this ability. Then, pick up to 2 friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT KNIGHTS** units within his combat range that are not in combat and have not used a **^^RUN^^** or **^^RETREAT^^** ability this turn to be his **royal retinue**. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
battleTraits.effect: The friendly **Ushoran** can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. He can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If he does so, he has charged. If he charged, then after this ability has been resolved, each unit in his **royal retinue** can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase and you can use the charge roll from this ability instead of making a charge roll when it does so, but it must end the charge move within 3" of the friendly **Ushoran**.

battleTraits.name: Nightmarish Charge
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** units that charged in the same turn.

heroicTraits.name: Tip of the King's Lance
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit charged this turn, it can move 2D6". It can pass through models in enemy units, but it must end that move in combat.

artifacts.name: Feted Coronet
artifacts.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** until a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** unit is destroyed.

battleTraits.name: Flying High
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^SKYVESSEL^^** that is in a regiment from which no units have been deployed, then pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are in its regiment.
battleTraits.effect: Set up all of those units in reserve **in the clouds**. They have now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: The Flagship
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^SKYVESSEL^^** to be the target. The target can be in reserve.
battleTraits.effect:
The target has the **FLAGSHIP** keyword for the rest of the battle. If the target does not have a Great Endrinwork, give the target 1 Great Endrinwork.
**Designer’s Note:** *This Great Endrinwork is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

battleTraits.name: Descend from the Clouds
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL in the clouds** to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that **^^SKYVESSEL^^** anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other units that were set up **in the clouds** with that **^^SKYVESSEL^^** wholly within 6" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Transport Skyfarers
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase, Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly SKYVESSEL
battleTraits.effect:
Pick a number of units up to that **^^SKYVESSEL^^**’s Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it and not in combat to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets.
Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the **^^SKYVESSEL^^** ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **^^SKYVESSEL^^** and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities if it was transported in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Skyvessel Cover
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **^^KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY^^** units that have not charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 6" of a friendly **Arkanaut Ironclad** or **Arkanaut Frigate** that has not charged in the same turn.

heroicTraits.name: Shrewd Opportunist
heroicTraits.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 other friendly **^^KHARADRON OVERLORDS^^** non-**^^HERO INFANTRY^^** units to be the targets.
heroicTraits.effect: Each target can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

heroicTraits.name: Bold As Brass
heroicTraits.effect: Add 5 to this unit’s control score.

heroicTraits.name: Combat Grafter
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^FIGHT^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the phase.

artifacts.name: Blazebeard and Sons Bamboozling Flakgun
artifacts.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a unit within 12" of this unit
artifacts.effect: Pick 1 dice in that charge roll. Then, make a **bamboozling flak roll** of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the value on the dice, remove that dice from the charge roll.

artifacts.name: Celestium Burst Grenade
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Voidstone Orb
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a WIZARD within 30" of this unit
artifacts.effect: That spell is unbound.

artifacts.name: Emberstone Flare
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly **^^KHARADRON OVERLORDS^^** unit that has **^^FLY^^** and is not in combat to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 9" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

artifacts.name: Karst-Bana Aether-Powered Combat Rig
artifacts.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

artifacts.name: Spell in a Bottle
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: This unit can use a **^^SUMMON^^** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Instead of making a casting roll for that **^^SUMMON^^** ability, the casting roll is 7 and cannot be modified. That **^^SUMMON^^** ability cannot be unbound.

artifacts.name: Persistent Drillbill
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• If the target unit’s starting size was 1, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

artifacts.name: Experimental Aether-Powered Ejector Rig
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artifacts.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a friendly **^^SKYVESSEL^^** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

artifacts.name: Heat-Seeking Auto-Endrin
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, subtract your opponent’s **fury level** from the target’s control score.
***Designer’s Note**: Use your opponent’s fury level at the point the unit’s control score is determined.*

otherEnhancements.name: Tracer-fire Rounds
otherEnhancements.timing: Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit
otherEnhancements.effect: If all of the attacks target the same enemy unit, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls for those attacks.

otherEnhancements.name: Coalbeard's Collapsible Bombrack
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to each dice roll when using this unit’s ‘Heavy Bomb Racks’, ‘Medium Bomb Racks’ or ‘Light Bomb Racks’ ability.

otherEnhancements.name: Gruksson Wide-bore Cylinders
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic.

otherEnhancements.name: Grandiose Fuselage
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 5 to this unit’s Control characteristic.

otherEnhancements.name: Hegsson Solutions 'Old Reliable' Hullplates
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** against damage inflicted by **^^SHOOT^^** abilities.

otherEnhancements.name: Nullstone Galvanisation
otherEnhancements.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on each enemy **^^MANIFESTATION^^** within this unit’s combat range.

otherEnhancements.name: Zonbarcorp 'Dealbreaker' Battle Ram
otherEnhancements.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

otherEnhancements.name: Voidstone Repulser Vents
otherEnhancements.timing: Reaction: A friendly unit within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of an enemy SPELL ability
otherEnhancements.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 4+:
• Ignore the effect of that spell on that friendly unit.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but you can only roll once for each friendly unit per spell cast.

otherEnhancements.name: Blazebeard and Sons Ejector Pod
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
otherEnhancements.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible friendly **^^KHARADRON OVERLORDS HERO^^** wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again wholly within 18" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

otherEnhancements.name: Artycle 25, Point 6
otherEnhancements.effect: Friendly **^^KHARADRON OVERLORDS HEROES^^** have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are within this unit’s combat range.

otherEnhancements.name: Artycle 15, Point 4
otherEnhancements.effect:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has **^^FLY^^**.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that does not have **^^FLY^^**.

otherEnhancements.name: Artycle 20, Amendment 2
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Charge Phase
otherEnhancements.declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: The target’s attacks cannot score critical hits for the rest of the turn (treat them as regular hits instead).

battleTraits.name: The Royal Crypt
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: This ability must be used instead of the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain Feature’ ability.
battleTraits.effect: Set up 3 **Cursed Sepulchres** wholly within friendly territory, each within ½" of any of the others and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, they have been deployed and they are considered to be a single **Cursed Sepulchre** terrain feature that has a Health characteristic of 24 instead of 8.

battleTraits.name: All to Dust
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: In the third and subsequent battle rounds, while a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** is on the battlefield, subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Endless Legions of Bone
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^UNIQUE BARROW LEGION^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^BARROW LEGION HERO^^** or wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.
If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities this turn.

battleTraits.name: Grave Sentinels
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: The melee weapons used by friendly **^^BARROW LEGION^^** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**.

battleTraits.name: Gifts to the Petty Kingdoms
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly non-**^^UNIQUE BARROW LEGION HEROES^^** that do not have an artefact of power to be the targets (you can pick units in reserve).
battleTraits.effect:
Give each target 1 artefact of power from the ‘Barrow Legion’ Army of Renown rules.
**Designer’s Note**: *These artefacts of power are given to the* **^^HEROES^^** *during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

heroicTraits.name: Lord of the Arcane Aegis
heroicTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following keywords:
• **^^INFANTRY^^**
• **^^CAVALRY^^**
• **^^MONSTER^^**
• **^^BEAST^^**
For the rest of the battle, each time an attack targets this unit, if the attacking unit has the keyword you picked, an unmodified save roll of 4+ for that attack is always successful.

heroicTraits.name: Spirit-eater
heroicTraits.effect: If any models were slain by your general this turn, **Heal (D6)** your general.

heroicTraits.name: Restless Tyrant
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BARROW LEGION^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Crypt Dagger
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy **^^HERO^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

artifacts.name: Crown of Cold Command
artifacts.timing: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BARROW LEGION^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• If the target is damaged, **Heal (3)** the target.
•  If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

artifacts.name: Grave-sand Pendant
artifacts.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

artifacts.name: Amulet of Nightmares
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** this phase.

artifacts.name: Ring of Stricken Souls
artifacts.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

battleTraits.name: Demands of the Dark Gods
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
***Demand of Khorne***: For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** units.
***Demand of Tzeentch***: Pick 1 visible enemy unit within 9" of a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that is not in combat and roll a D6. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
***Demand of Nurgle***: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit. Then pick a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that healed any damage points this turn. Until the start of the next battle round, that unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.
***Demand of Slaanesh***: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** units until the start of the next battle round.

battleTraits.name: Descent From Ruinous Skies
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that is **in the Ruinous Skies**.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Knights of the First Circle
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: If there are more friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Ruinous Skies**. It has now been deployed.

otherEnhancements.name: The Blackstorm Apostates
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 3" to this unit’s Move characteristic.

otherEnhancements.name: Tamers of Haradh's Torment
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons.

otherEnhancements.name: Betrayers of the Anvilking
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

otherEnhancements.name: The Hounds Apocalyptus
otherEnhancements.effect: While this unit is wholly within enemy territory, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

otherEnhancements.name: The Grimroot Order
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s Health characteristic.

battleTraits.name: Ancient Burial Sites
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.effect:
If there is a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional **Cursed Sepulchres** on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.
**Designer’s Note**: *The original* **Cursed Sepulchre** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

battleTraits.name: The Rising Dead
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **in the grave**.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** and more than 9" from all enemy units, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Deathly Invocation
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO^^** to use this ability, then pick up to 3 friendly **^^DEATHRATTLE^^** or **^^DEADWALKERS^^** units wholly within 12" of that **^^HERO^^** to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
For each target:
• If the target is damaged, **Heal (3)** the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

battleTraits.name: Endless Legions
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^UNIQUE DEATHRATTLE^^** or **^^DEADWALKERS^^** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO^^** or wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.
If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities this turn.

battleTraits.name: The Hunger
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick each friendly **^^VAMPIRE^^** unit that used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability this turn to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: **Heal (D3)** each target. **Heal (2D3)** the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a **^^FIGHT^^** ability.

battleTraits.name: The Unquiet Dead
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^DEATHRATTLE^^** or **^^DEADWALKERS^^** unit that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the grave**. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units **in the grave** than there are on the battlefield.

heroicTraits.name: Unbending Will
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^DEATHRATTLE^^** or **^^DEADWALKERS^^** unit that has 2 or more models and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Add D6 to the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Lash of the Sire
heroicTraits.declare: Pick another friendly **^^SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS^^** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+:
•  If the target is not in combat, it can move D6" but cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
•  If the target is in combat, it can make a pile‑in move.

heroicTraits.name: Unhinged Rampager
heroicTraits.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit in your charge phase.

heroicTraits.name: Immortal Ego
heroicTraits.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

heroicTraits.name: A Wastrel and a Vagabond
heroicTraits.effect:
While a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** or **Deathrattle Skeletons** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Add 2 to run rolls for that unit.
• Add 3" to the distance that unit can move when it piles in.

heroicTraits.name: Frightening Vitality
heroicTraits.effect: Each time an ability would heal exactly 1 or 2 of this unit’s damage points, heal 3 damage points instead.

heroicTraits.name: Immortal Ego
heroicTraits.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Furious Endings
heroicTraits.effect: Each time a **^^MANIFESTATION^^** within 12" of this unit is removed from play, gain 1 **rage dice**.

heroicTraits.name: Eternal Thrall
heroicTraits.declare: Pick another friendly non-**^^UNIQUE SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HERO^^** to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while the target is on the battlefield:
• If this unit is a **Necromancer**, add 1 to this unit’s power level.
• If this unit is a **^^VAMPIRE^^**, add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.
• If this unit is **^^DEATHRATTLE^^**, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

artifacts.name: Shard of Night
artifacts.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).

artifacts.name: Terminus Clock
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **^^WIZARDS^^** while they are within 18" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Amulet of Graves
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Cursed Sepulchres** on the battlefield, set up a **Cursed Sepulchre** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 1" from all friendly units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

otherEnhancements.name: The Empty Graveyard
otherEnhancements.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 7" of a terrain feature or wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge. This unit cannot use **^^MOVE^^** abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.

otherEnhancements.name: The Never-Dead
otherEnhancements.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 5+ for an attack that targets this unit, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends

otherEnhancements.name: The Incarnadine Killers
otherEnhancements.effect: If this unit is not in combat and an enemy unit was destroyed by its combat attacks this turn, this unit can move up to D6". It can end that move in combat.

battleTraits.name: Propa Grisly
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER^^** unit that has not used any **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a number of dice equal to the Health characteristic of that **^^MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER^^**. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: After It, Ladz!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER^^** unit that was not set up this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

battleTraits.name: Crawly Swarm
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **^^MURKVAST MENAGERIE^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER^^** that has not charged this turn.

heroicTraits.name: Grim Diet
heroicTraits.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

artifacts.name: Skinwriggla Larvae
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick an objective within 6" of this unit to be **infested with bugs** for the rest of the battle.
artifacts.effect:
While an enemy unit is contesting an objective that is **infested with bugs**:
• Subtract 3 from that unit’s control score.
• Ignore positive modifiers to that unit’s control score.

battleTraits.name: Plague of Misery
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: While enemy units are within 12" of any friendly **^^CYCLE OF CORRUPTION^^** units, they cannot use abilities that heal or return slain models to a unit.

battleTraits.name: Nauseous Revulsion
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Unnatural Vitality
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Friendly non-**^^MONSTER CYCLE OF CORRUPTION HEROES^^** have **^^Ward (4+)^^**.

battleTraits.name: Burgeoning Filth
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **^^CYCLE OF CORRUPTION^^** units.

battleTraits.name: Corrupted Regrowth
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
**Heal (7)** each friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw**.
If there are no friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws** on the battlefield, you can set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

battleTraits.name: Rampant Disease
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly non-**^^HERO CYCLE OF CORRUPTION^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

battleTraits.name: Revolution and Revulsion
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each battle round.
battleTraits.effect:
If it is the first battle round, roll a dice to determine which **^^CYCLE^^** ability is ripe for the rest of the battle round.
1 ‘Unnatural Vitality’
2 ‘Fecund Vigour’
3 ‘Burgeoning Filth’
4 ‘Plague of Misery’
5 ‘Nauseous Revulsion’
6 ‘Rampant Disease’
7 ‘Corrupted Regrowth’
If it is not the first battle round, the next **^^CYCLE^^** ability in the sequence is ripe for the rest of the battle round. If the ‘Corrupted Regrowth’ ability was ripe last battle round, the ‘Unnatural Vitality’ ability is ripe this battle round.
You can only use a **^^CYCLE^^** ability if it is ripe. Only 1 **^^CYCLE^^** ability is ripe each battle round.

battleTraits.name: Fecund Vigour
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: **HEAL (D3)** each friendly **^^CYCLE OF CORRUPTION^^** unit.

heroicTraits.name: Utterly Disgusting
heroicTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

artifacts.name: Cankerous Nail
artifacts.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

battleTraits.name: Ninefold Blessings
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if the total value of your unspent **destiny dice** is exactly 9.
battleTraits.effect:
Re-roll all of your unspent **destiny dice**. Then, until the start of your next turn:
• Friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.
**Designer’s Note:** *Add together the values shown on each unspent destiny dice to find the total value.*

battleTraits.name: Masters of Destiny
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.effect:
Roll 9 dice and place them to one side. These are your **destiny dice**. **Destiny dice** can be spent during the battle to change certain dice rolls. You can never have more than 9 **destiny dice** at once.
During the battle, instead of making a roll from the list below for a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** unit, you can spend your **destiny dice**. The roll you would have made is replaced with the roll on the **destiny dice** you spend. If you want to replace a 2D6 roll, 3D6 roll, etc. you must spend a number of destiny dice equal to the number before ‘D6’. Any rolls that have been replaced count as unmodified rolls, and they cannot be re-rolled or modified by other friendly abilities except for those that apply negative modifiers (but they can be modified by enemy abilities). You cannot spend destiny dice to replace re-rolls.
**Destiny dice** can be spent in place of the following dice rolls:
• Casting rolls
• Unbinding rolls
• Banishment rolls
• Run rolls
• Charge rolls in your turn
• Hit rolls
• Wound rolls
• Save rolls

heroicTraits.name: Nexus of Fate
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a dice. If you have 9 unspent **destiny dice**, you must replace 1 of your **destiny dice** with that roll. Otherwise, place that dice to one side as a **destiny dice**.

artifacts.name: Corrupted Leystone
artifacts.effect: If this unit is contesting an objective, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again contesting an objective and more than 7" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Transplanting
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 3" of a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE HERO** and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

battleTraits.name: Sickly Sores
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: While a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE INFANTRY** unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw**, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to it in each phase.

battleTraits.name: Putrescent Sap
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick each enemy unit within 3" of any friendly **Feculent**^^ ^^**Gnarlmaws** to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: The Head Gardener
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.effect: The friendly **Horticulous Slimux** can use his ‘Cultivating the Garden of Nurgle’ ability this phase even if there are 1 or more friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws** on the battlefield.

battleTraits.name: Foul Fauna
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE**^^ ^^**Beasts of Nurgle** and **Plague Drones** units while they are wholly within 6" of any friendly **Feculent**^^ ^^**Gnarlmaws**.

battleTraits.name: The Garden Grows
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: Set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

heroicTraits.name: Foetid Orchardist
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks while it is wholly within 7" of any friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws**.

artifacts.name: Stinking Sporeseed
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
artifacts.effect: Set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** within 3" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

battleTraits.name: Guided by Morai-Heg
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of combat attacks made by friendly non-**^^HERO INFANTRY^^** units while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **Krethusa**.

battleTraits.name: Skilled Skirmishers
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS CAVALRY** unit that has not charged this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On 3+, the target can immediately use a **^^RETREAT^^** ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by that **^^RETREAT^^** ability.

battleTraits.name: Plumes of Auspicious Smoke
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
Friendly **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** units are either **empty** or **full**. They start the battle **empty**. While a friendly **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** unit is **full**:
• That **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage points inflicted by shooting attacks.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** units while they are wholly within 9" of that **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit**.

battleTraits.name: Laden with Prophecy
battleTraits.timing: End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **empty Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit**.
battleTraits.effect: If any enemy models were slain this turn by that **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit'**s combat attacks, it becomes **full**.

battleTraits.name: The Blood Reveals All
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS HERO** within the combat range of a friendly **empty**^^ ^^**Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit**. Then, pick another unit within the combat range of that **^^HERO^^** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. Allocate a number of damage points to the target equal to the roll (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, that **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** becomes **full**.

heroicTraits.name: Proselyte of Morai-Heg
heroicTraits.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

artifacts.name: Blade of Prophetic Doom
artifacts.timing: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+:
• If the target is not damaged, inflict 1 mortal damage on it.
• If the target is damaged, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: Revel in Battle
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by enemy units that charged this turn and that target a friendly **^^BLADES OF KHORNE^^** unit have no effect.

battleTraits.name: Glorious Combat or Naught
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **^^BLADES OF KHORNE^^** units.

battleTraits.name: Cleave Wide the Grin of Khorne
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^BLADES OF KHORNE^^** units.

battleTraits.name: Punish the Pacifist
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Each unit (friendly and enemy) and enemy **^^MANIFESTATION^^** that is not in combat is a target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target.

battleTraits.name: Murder the Mystic
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 4 enemy **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^** to be the target(s).
battleTraits.effect: Make a **banishment roll** of 2D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on that **^^MANIFESTATION^^**'s warscroll, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of it and then it is **banished** and removed from play.

battleTraits.name: Blood-drenched
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the ‘Skulls for the Skull Throne’ ability
battleTraits.effect:
After that ability has been resolved, if you unlocked a **^^BLOOD TITHE^^** ability this turn, pick a friendly **^^BLADES OF KHORNE^^** unit to be the target. The following effects apply to the target for the rest of the battle:
***Wild-eyed Brutality:*** Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
***Blood Haze:*** If the target is **^^BLOODBOUND^^**, its **Blood-hungry** weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.
***Weapons of Murder:***  If the target is a non-**^^MONSTER DAEMON^^** unit, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its **Blood-hungry** weapons, including **Blood-hungry Companion** weapons.
***Bloodlords Supreme:*** If the target is a **^^MONSTER^^**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its **Blood-hungry** weapons.

battleTraits.name: Blood for the Blood God
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Earn 1 blood tithe point each time a unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed. Blood tithe points are spent to unlock **^^BLOOD TITHE^^** abilities. You can only use **^^BLOOD TITHE^^** abilities that are unlocked. Once a **^^BLOOD TITHE^^** ability is unlocked, you do not need to spend further blood tithe points to use it.

battleTraits.name: Divine Scorn
battleTraits.timing: Once per Turn, Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy **^^WIZARDS^^** or **^^PRIESTS^^** within 6" of any friendly **^^BLADES OF KHORNE^^** units to be the target(s).
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of the next turn.

battleTraits.name: Murderlust
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. You can replace one of the dice in the charge roll with that value. If you do so, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit using that **^^CHARGE^^** ability after that ability is resolved.

battleTraits.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: Pick a **^^BLOOD TITHE^^** ability that you have not unlocked and spend the number of blood tithe points required to unlock that ability (shown in the top-right corner of the ability). That **^^BLOOD TITHE^^** ability is now unlocked for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Slaughter Triumphant
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by friendly **^^BLADES OF KHORNE^^** units that charged in the same turn.

heroicTraits.name: Skull Collector
heroicTraits.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **^^HERO^^** by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy **^^HERO^^** has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle.
This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

heroicTraits.name: Frenzied Taskmaster
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^BLADES OF KHORNE INFANTRY^^** or **^^CAVALRY^^** unit within this unit's combat range that is not in combat to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: The target can move D6" but cannot end that move in combat. If the target ends that move within this unit's combat range, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

heroicTraits.name: Magical Scorn
heroicTraits.effect:
Subtract 1 from casting rolls for **^^WIZARDS^^** while they are within 12" of this unit.
Subtract 1 from chanting rolls for enemy **^^PRIESTS^^** while they are within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Collar of Contempt
artifacts.effect: This unit can use **^^UNBIND^^** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1).** Each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

artifacts.name: Butcher's Blade
artifacts.declare: Pick each enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's combat attacks to be the targets.
artifacts.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

artifacts.name: Ar'gath, The King of Blades
artifacts.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy **^^HEROES^^** while they are in combat with this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Scorpion Tails
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect:
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• If the target unit’s starting size was 1, subtract 1 from wound rolls for its combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Brass Flesh
otherEnhancements.effect: Unmodified save rolls of 5+ for this unit cannot fail.

otherEnhancements.name: Blade-Limbs
otherEnhancements.effect: Each time this unit is picked to use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for the attacks made as part of that ability, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit instead of D3.

battleTraits.name: World Runes
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.effect:
Add 1 **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** to your **library** for each friendly **^^ALARITH^^** unit on the battlefield.
Add 1 **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** to your **library** for each friendly **^^HURAKAN^^** unit on the battlefield.
Add 1 **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** to your **library** for each friendly **^^YDRILAN^^** unit on the battlefield.
You can have a maximum of 6 of each type of rune in your **library**.

battleTraits.name: Depict Rune
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability.
battleTraits.effect:
Remove all runes from your **battle scripture**. Then, pick any number of runes to remove from your **library** and depict them on your **battle scripture**. Runes removed from your library in this way are removed for the rest of the battle.
**Designer’s Note:** *Runes are used to activate powerful abilities on your units’ warscrolls.*

battleTraits.name: Entreat Spirits
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can use this ability if you have 3 or more runes in your **library**. Pick a friendly non- **^^UNIQUE MONSTER^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Remove any 3 runes from your **library**. Then, set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Allocate 6 damage points to the replacement unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battleTraits.name: The Realms Fight Back
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a terrain feature. Then, pick an enemy unit within 6" of that terrain feature to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a D3 and apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn.
**1.  Eruption of Earth:** Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.
**2.  Howling Winds:** Subtract 5 from the target’s control score.
**3.  Flash Flood:** The target has **STRIKE-LAST**.

heroicTraits.name: World-Mage
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for each unique rune depicted on your **battle scripture**.

artifacts.name: Aelementor Focus
artifacts.declare: Pick a terrain feature to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Measure the range and visibility of the next **^^SPELL^^** ability used by this unit from the target instead of from this unit.

battleTraits.name: Run Roughshod
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE^^** unit in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
•  The target can use **^^SHOOT^^** and/or **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RETREAT^^** ability in the same turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **^^RETREAT^^** abilities.

battleTraits.name: 'Break Them, One and All...'
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Any number of friendly **^^ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE^^** units can use the ‘Power Through’ command in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Let The Realms Tremble
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add **X** to charge rolls for friendly **^^ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE^^** units, where **X** is the number of friendly **^^ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE^^** units that have already charged this phase.

heroicTraits.name: Raging Animus
heroicTraits.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

artifacts.name: Visage of the Great Bull
artifacts.effect: In your charge phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

battleTraits.name: Desperate Remedies
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: If an ability would heal or return slain models to a **DISEASED** enemy unit, that ability does not heal or return any slain models to it. Instead, it no longer has the **DISEASED** keyword.

battleTraits.name: Burst Pustules
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Each time a **DISEASED** enemy unit is destroyed, before the last model in the unit is removed from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick another enemy unit within 9" of that model to be the target. You cannot pick a **^^MANIFESTATION^^** or terrain feature. The target has the **DISEASED** keyword.

battleTraits.name: Wracked with Disease
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick each **DISEASED** enemy unit to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

battleTraits.name: Blessed by the Plaguefather
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
***Infect:*** Pick an enemy unit within 7" of any friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle units to be the target. You cannot pick a **^^MANIFESTATION^^** or terrain feature.
• If the target is in combat with any friendly **^^MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE^^** units, it has the **DISEASED** keyword.
• If the target is not in combat with any friendly **^^MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE^^** units, roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has the **DISEASED** keyword.
***Spread:*** Pick a **DISEASED** enemy unit to be the target. Each other enemy unit within the target’s combat range, excluding **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^** and terrain features, has the **DISEASED** keyword.
***Mutate:*** If all enemy units on the battlefield, excluding **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^** and terrain features, have the **DISEASED** keyword, inflict 1 mortal damage on each of them.

battleTraits.name: Ceaseless Infectors
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was in combat with a friendly **^^ROTBRINGERS^^** unit that was destroyed this turn to be the target. You cannot pick a **^^MANIFESTATION^^** or terrain feature.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has the **DISEASED** keyword.

battleTraits.name: Blighted Regrowth
battleTraits.timing: Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can use this ability if there are no friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws** on the battlefield.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield wholly within 12" of an objective you control and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

heroicTraits.name: Unctuous Preacher
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is not a **^^PRIEST^^**, it has **PRIEST (1)**. If this unit is already a **^^PRIEST^^**, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Corpulent Avalanche
heroicTraits.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
Roll a number of dice equal to this unit’s Move characteristic. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
If any damage points were allocated to the target by this ability, this unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.

heroicTraits.name: Living Plague
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: The target has the **DISEASED** keyword.

heroicTraits.name: Grandfather's Blessing
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is in combat with a **Diseased** enemy unit, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Gift of Febrile Frenzy
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**^^HERO MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE^^** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Overpowering Stench
heroicTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
You and your opponent must roll off. If your roll is higher, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.

artifacts.name: Rustfang
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy **^^HERO^^** or **^^MONSTER^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: The Witherstave
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: The Carrion Dirge
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
artifacts.effect: Subtract 5 from each target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Snuggling Sickness
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Each time the target uses a **^^RETREAT^^** ability, if it is in combat with this unit, roll 2D6 as a reaction and add the target’s Control characteristic to the roll. On an 8+, that **^^RETREAT^^** ability has no effect.
• The target cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.

otherEnhancements.name: Chuckling Murrain
otherEnhancements.effect:
Your opponent must spend 1 additional **rage dice** for a unit to use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability while it is in combat with this unit.
When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with this unit, each time your opponent would spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, they must spend 1 additional **rage dice**.
In both cases, that additional dice does not count towards the number of **rage dice** spent for the purposes of the ability.

otherEnhancements.name: The Weeping Flux
otherEnhancements.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack, roll a number of dice equal to this unit’s Health characteristic. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit.

battleTraits.name: Surprise, Ya Gitz!
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **DROGGZ’S GITMOB** unit that is **outflanking the enemy**.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Glowering Light
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **DROGGZ’S GITMOB** unit that has charged this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target cannot make a pile-in move when it is picked to use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability.

battleTraits.name: Get Around 'Em
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **DROGGZ’S GITMOB** unit that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **outflanking the enemy**. It has now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: Dis Fight's Not Fer Me
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^DROGGZ'S GITMOB^^** unit that is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn and is not in combat with any enemy units that did not charge this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

heroicTraits.name: Plucky Git
heroicTraits.effect: While this unit has no damage points, friendly **DROGGZ'S**^^ ^^**^^GITMOB^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 9" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Stick 'Em and Run
heroicTraits.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^RETREAT^^** ability or the ‘Frazzlegit’s Flame Stream’ ability, before moving this unit, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

artifacts.name: Glareface's Grin
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit. Each visible enemy unit within 3" of that point is a target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: Rune of Fiery Determination
