battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^UR-GOLD RUNE^^** abilities this battle round.
Friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: Rune of Relentless Zeal
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any **UR-GOLD RUNE A**bilities this battle round.
For the rest of the battle round, friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS^^** units can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if they used a **^^RUN^^** ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Rune of Fury
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any **UR-GOLD RUNE A**bilities this battle round.
For the rest of the battle round, friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS^^** units have **STRIKE-FIRST** while they are in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Rune of Searing Heat
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^UR-GOLD RUNE^^** abilities this battle round.
Melee weapons used by friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS^^** units have **Crit**^^ ^^**(Mortal)** for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: Rune of Farsight
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^UR-GOLD RUNE^^** abilities this battle round. Pick any number of enemy units within 10" of and visible to any friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS^^** units to be targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. In addition, for the rest of the battle round, ranged weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

heroicTraits.name: Fiercely Competitive
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that has **STRIKE-FIRST**, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST**. If this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that uses the ‘All-out Attack’ command, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Blood of the Berzerker
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Ash-beard
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is not a **^^PRIEST^^**, they have **PRIEST (1)**. If this unit was already a **^^PRIEST^^**, add 1 to this unit’s chanting rolls.

artifacts.name: Draught of the Finest Magmalt
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artifacts.effect: Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Droth-helm
artifacts.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for **Companion** weapons used by friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Ash-cloud Rune
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **^^INFANTRY^^** units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Incandescent Blaze
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
otherEnhancements.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Roaring Fyrestream**.
• This unit’s **Roaring Fyrestream** has a Damage characteristic of 3.

otherEnhancements.name: Peerless Lineage
otherEnhancements.timing: Reaction: You declared a RAMPAGE ability for this unit
otherEnhancements.effect: You can pick another eligible unit to be a second target of that **^^RAMPAGE^^** ability. If the ability requires a roll, you must roll for each target.

otherEnhancements.name: Thickened Scales
otherEnhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Thickened Scales
otherEnhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Aureate Hide
otherEnhancements.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
otherEnhancements.effect: After that **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by that **^^FIGHT^^** ability, you can pick a visible friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS PRIEST^^** wholly within 12" of this unit. Give that **^^PRIEST^^** D3 ritual points.

otherEnhancements.name: Intense Fyrestream
otherEnhancements.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Add **X**" to the Range characteristic and **X** to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** ranged weapons, where X is equal to your **fury level**.
• This unit’s **Companion** ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat**.

battleTraits.name: Jade Haven
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: The Health characteristic of your **Soulpod Grove** is 18. The **creeping overgrowth** extends 12" from your **Soulpod Grove**.

battleTraits.name: Heart of the Forest
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: You cannot allocate more than 10 damage points per phase to a friendly **^^SOULPOD GUARDIANS^^** unit while it is wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove** (remaining damage points inflicted on it in that phase have no effect).

battleTraits.name: The Sacred Groves
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability.
battleTraits.effect:
Set up 3 **Awakened Wyldwoods** (an Awakened Wyldwood is a single tree miniature with a crescent-shaped base) wholly within friendly territory, more than 1" from all other terrain features and more than 3" from all objectives. The tips of each crescent-shaped base must touch, forming a circle.
Once you have done so, for the rest of the battle, the 3 tree miniatures join to form 1 **Soulpod Grove** terrain feature. The area inside the circle formed by the trees is part of the terrain feature

battleTraits.name: Vengeance for the Lost
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: If your **Soulpod Grove** has been demolished this battle, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly **^^SOULPOD GUARDIANS^^** units’ melee weapons.

heroicTraits.name: Devoted Protector
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is destroyed while it is wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove**, before removing this unit from the battlefield, **Heal (10)** your **Soulpod Grove**.

artifacts.name: Clarionbuds
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
artifacts.declare: If there is an enemy unit wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove**, pick up to 3 friendly **^^SOULPOD GUARDIANS^^** units to be the targets.
artifacts.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove** and more than 6" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Trophy Hunta
heroicTraits.effect: This unit’s **Pig-hakka** has **Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)** and **Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**.

artifacts.name: Da Boom Skull
artifacts.timing: Reaction: You declared a command for a friendly GRUNTA STAMPEDE unit wholly within 18" of this unit
artifacts.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: Pledge to Chaos
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^UNIQUE SLAVES TO DARKNESS^^** unit that does not already have one of the keywords below to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following **Pledge to Chaos** keywords:
• **^^PLEDGED TO KHORNE^^**
• **^^PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH^^**
• **^^PLEDGED TO NURGLE^^**
• **^^PLEDGED TO SLAANESH^^**
The target has that keyword for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Dark Apotheosis
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit with 8 or more **Dark Apotheosis** points to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following:
***Aura of Chaos***: **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is the number of damage points allocated to the target. In addition, the target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the battle.
***Daemonhood***: Set up a **Daemon Prince** within 1" of the target. Then, remove the target from the battlefield. If the target is your general, the **Daemon Prince** becomes your general instead and is added to your general’s regiment. If the target has any enhancements, the **Daemon Prince** has those enhancements instead. If the target has a **Pledge to Chaos** keyword, the **Daemon Prince** has the same keyword. Otherwise, pick 1 **Pledge to Chaos** keyword for the **Daemon Prince** to have for the rest of the battle. If any **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^** that were summoned by the target are on the battlefield, those **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^** are removed from play.

battleTraits.name: Pledged to Nurgle
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Friendly **^^PLEDGED TO NURGLE^^** units have **WARD (6+).** If a unit already has **WARD (6+),** it has **^^Ward (5+)^^** instead.

battleTraits.name: Pledged to Khorne
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^PLEDGED TO KHORNE^^** units.

battleTraits.name: Pledged to Slaanesh
battleTraits.timing: Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for friendly **^^PLEDGED TO SLAANESH^^** units, you can roll 1 additional dice (to a maximum of 3), but if you do, you must discard 1 dice of your choice.

battleTraits.name: Eye of the Gods
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^UNIQUE WARRIORS OF CHAOS^^** or **^^DARKOATH HERO^^** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
During the battle, the target gains **Dark Apotheosis** points as follows:
• Each time the target uses a **^^FIGHT^^** ability, it gains D3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.
• At the end of each of your turns, if the target is contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory, it gains D3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

battleTraits.name: Pledged to Tzeentch
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH^^** unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll 2D6. Then pick a point within a number of inches of the target equal to the roll. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Favoured of the Pantheon
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is picked as the target of the ‘Eye of the Gods’ ability, it gains 3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

heroicTraits.name: Deathmonger
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^FIGHT^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Radiance of Dark Glory
heroicTraits.declare: Pick each damaged friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, **Heal (1)** the target. **Heal**^^ ^^**(3)** the target instead if it is a **^^MONSTER^^**.

artifacts.name: Head of the Unworthy
artifacts.effect: If a friendly **^^SLAVES TO DARKNESS HERO^^** with any **Dark Apotheosis** points is destroyed, give this unit 8 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

artifacts.name: Amulet of Chaos
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **^^DARKOATH INFANTRY^^** unit in combat with that enemy unit to be the friendly target.
artifacts.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
• If there is a friendly target, return a number of slain models to it equal to the roll.

artifacts.name: The Varanite Shackle
artifacts.effect: Friendly non-**^^WARRIORS OF CHAOS SLAVES TO DARKNESS^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Realmwarper's Twist-rune
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: If the target does not have the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability, it gains that ability until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a dice for each model (friendly and enemy) within 1" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model’s unit.

artifacts.name: Infernal Puppet
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^WIZARD^^** within 24" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target is picked to use a **^^SPELL^^** ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target as a reaction. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **^^SPELL^^** ability.

artifacts.name: The Conqueror's Crown
artifacts.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **^^INFANTRY^^** units while they are in combat with this unit.

artifacts.name: Aelfskin Scroll
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a WIZARD within 18" of this unit
artifacts.effect: Pick a visible friendly **^^SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD^^** within 18" of this unit. After that **^^SPELL^^** ability has been resolved, that friendly **^^WIZARD^^** can use a **^^SPELL^^** ability as if it were your hero phase, and the casting roll for that spell is equal to the casting roll for that enemy spell. Do not count that spell towards the number of **^^SPELL^^** abilities that friendly **^^WIZARD^^** can use this phase.

artifacts.name: Darkflame Pendant
artifacts.effect: Weapons used for attacks that target this unit have a maximum Damage characteristic of 1.

artifacts.name: Rune of Murder
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Inflict 3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, double the target weapon’s Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
• Add D6 to the target weapon’s Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: The Banner of Rage
otherEnhancements.effect:
This unit has the **^^PLEDGED TO KHORNE^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.

otherEnhancements.name: The Banner of Screaming Flesh
otherEnhancements.effect:
This unit has the **^^PLEDGED TO SLAANESH^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, if this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: The Dread Banner
otherEnhancements.effect: While this unit includes any standard bearers, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: The Eroding Icon
otherEnhancements.effect:
This unit has the **^^PLEDGED TO NURGLE^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

otherEnhancements.name: The Blasted Standard
otherEnhancements.effect:
This unit has the **^^PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, this unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.

otherEnhancements.name: Brand of Unbreakable Bonds
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
otherEnhancements.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of an objective you control and not in combat. This unit cannot use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Brand of Apoplexy
otherEnhancements.effect: While your **fury level** is 7, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s weapons.

otherEnhancements.name: Brand of the Unaligned
otherEnhancements.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it has an Ensorcelled Banner.
otherEnhancements.effect:
Remove all of this unit’s **Pledge to Chaos** keywords. Then, pick 1 of the following **Pledge to Chaos** keywords. You cannot pick a keyword you picked for this unit earlier in the battle.
**• Pledged to Khorne**
**• Pledged to Tzeentch**
**• Pledged to Nurgle**
**• Pledged to Slaanesh**
This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Recruitment Drive
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^EXQUISITE PLOT^^** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the **hunter** and an enemy unit with 5 or more models to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the **hunter**’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit. In addition, if the target is destroyed this turn by the **hunter**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the **hunter**’s melee weapons for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Seek Worthy Blood
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^EXQUISITE PLOT^^** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target’s weapons have **Anti-HERO (+1 Rend)**. In addition, if the target destroys any enemy **^^HEROES^^** this turn, the target’s weapons have **Anti-HERO (+1 Rend)** for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: The Queen's Prize
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^EXQUISITE PLOT^^** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the turn, add 5 to the target’s control score.
In addition, at the end of this turn, after determining control of objectives, if the target is contesting an objective that you control and that was controlled by your opponent at the start of this turn, add 5 to the target’s control score for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Thaumic Realignment
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **^^EXQUISITE PLOT^^** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly **^^WIZARD^^** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to casting rolls for the target. In addition, at the end of this turn, if the target successfully cast any spells this turn, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the battle.

heroicTraits.name: Keeper of the Royal Menagerie
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

artifacts.name: Amulet of Leeches
artifacts.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Dire**^^ ^^**Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit:
• This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell**^^ ^^**Bats** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battleTraits.name: Twin Tides
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an **^^ATTACK^^** ability for a friendly **^^AKHELIAN^^** unit
battleTraits.usedBy: The friendly **^^AKHELIAN^^** unit using that **^^ATTACK^^** ability.
battleTraits.effect:
Pick a visible friendly **^^NAMARTI^^** unit that has not used an **^^ATTACK^^** ability this phase to be the target.
•  If this unit used a **^^SHOOT^^** ability, immediately after the **^^SHOOT^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **^^SHOOT^^** ability as if it were your shooting phase.
•  If this unit used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability, immediately after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability. If the target does so, for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons but all of its attacks must target enemy units that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s attacks.

heroicTraits.name: Endless Sea-storm
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
heroicTraits.effect:
If this unit is a **^^WIZARD^^**, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the turn. If this unit is not a **^^WIZARD^^**, it gains **WIZARD (1)** for the rest of the turn.
In addition, add 2 to the next casting roll or banishment roll for this unit this turn.

heroicTraits.name: Merciless Raider
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is within 6" of a damaged enemy unit, this unit can move 6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with a damaged enemy unit.

heroicTraits.name: Lord of Storm and Sea
heroicTraits.effect: Each time an ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

heroicTraits.name: Form of the Fangmora
heroicTraits.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

heroicTraits.name: Hunter of Souls
heroicTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following weapon abilities for this unit’s melee weapons to have this battle:
•  **Anti-CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**
•  **Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend)**
•  **Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)**

heroicTraits.name: Nightmare Legacy
heroicTraits.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Cursed Lineage
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your opponent’s **fury level**. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

heroicTraits.name: Abyssal Dweller
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
heroicTraits.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while enemy units are contesting the target objective:
• Those units cannot use **^^RUN^^**, **^^RETREAT^^** or **^^CHARGE^^** abilities.

heroicTraits.name: Adherent of Kir-Nadarr
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
For the rest of the turn, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^IDONETH DEEPKIN^^** units that target that enemy unit.

artifacts.name: Lifekelp Pod
artifacts.effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **^^IDONETH DEEPKIN CAVALRY^^** unit within this unit’s combat range.

artifacts.name: Dritchleech
artifacts.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **^^WIZARDS^^** while they are within 18" of this unit. In addition, each time an enemy spell fails, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (1)** this unit.

artifacts.name: Armour of the Cythai
artifacts.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Ironshell Barnacles
otherEnhancements.effect:
• If this unit is **^^INFANTRY^^**, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.
• If this unit is **^^CAVALRY^^**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.
• If this unit is a **^^MONSTER^^**, ignore negative modifiers to run rolls and charge rolls for it.

otherEnhancements.name: Stonefoot Anemone
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use **^^MOVE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Aqshian Sea Nettles
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Other enemy units cannot use **^^FIGHT^^** abilities if the target is eligible to be picked.
• If possible, this unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
• All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.
**Designer’s Note**: *This ability does not override the* **STRIKE-FIRST** *or* **STRIKE-LAST** *constraints.*

battleTraits.name: Ethereal
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT^^** units, excluding **Nagash.**

battleTraits.name: Gather Power
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
The following effects apply to the friendly **Nagash** during the first and second battle rounds, as shown:
**Battle Round 1:**
• His Move characteristic is'-' and he cannot make pile-in moves.
• He has **WARD (3+).**
• He has a Control characteristic of 1.
• **Alakanash** and **Zefet-nebtar** each have an Attacks characteristic of 2 instead of 4.
**Battle Round 2:**
• His Move characteristic is 6".
• He cannot end a move more than 6" from the **ritual site.**
• He has **WARD (4+).**
• He has a Control characteristic of 5.
• **Alakanash** and **Zefet-nebtar** each have an Attacks characteristic of 2 instead of 4.

battleTraits.name: Unholy Vessel
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: The **ritual site** has **^^Ward (4+)^^** and cannot use the 'Hungry Crypts' ability.

battleTraits.name: The Ritual Begins
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability to set up the friendly **Nagash.** Pick a friendly **Nexus of Grief** wholly within friendly territory to be the **ritual site.**
battleTraits.effect: Set up the friendly **Nagash** within 1" of the **ritual site** and wholly within friendly territory. After you have done so, he has been **deployed.** That **Nexus of Grief** is the **ritual site** for the rest of the battle.

heroicTraits.name: Damned Vessel
heroicTraits.effect: Whenever you declare a **^^SPELL^^** ability for a friendly **Nagash** within 18" of this unit, you can measure the range and visibility of that **^^SPELL^^** ability from this unit instead of that **Nagash**.

artifacts.name: The Seal of Nagash
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: Allocate 3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, **Heal (3)** the friendly **Nagash.**

battleTraits.name: Destined for Battle
battleTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^CHARGE^^** ability for a **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** unit in your turn
battleTraits.effect: Spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, add 1 to the charge roll for that **^^CHARGE^^** ability.

battleTraits.name: Silver Simulacrum
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.effect:
If there is a friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional **Argent Shard** on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.
**Designer’s Note:** *The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

battleTraits.name: Smoke and Mirrors
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** unit that was not set up this turn and was not set up using this ability in the previous turn to be the target, then pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the substitute.
battleTraits.effect: Set up the substitute wholly within 6" of the target and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **masked by illusion**.

battleTraits.name: Destined Arcana
battleTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^SPELL^^** ability for a **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** unit
battleTraits.effect: Spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, add 1 to the casting roll for that spell.

battleTraits.name: Eldritch Illusions
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**^^MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** units on the battlefield to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up in reserve **masked by illusion**.
Friendly units that are **masked by illusion** are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round.

battleTraits.name: Destined to Serve
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Before allocating damage points to a friendly **DISCIPLES OF**^^ ^^**TZEENTCH** unit, you can spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, remove 1 damage point in that unit’s damage pool.

battleTraits.name: All Part of the Plan
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
You start the battle with 0 **fate points**.
Gain 1 **fate point** each time:
• You lose the priority roll.
• A spell cast by a friendly **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** unit is unbound.
• A friendly **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** unit miscasts a spell.
• Your opponent gains control of an objective that you controlled at the start of the turn.
• A friendly **Argent Shard** is **demolished**.
You can have a maximum of 9 fate points.

heroicTraits.name: Devolving Aura
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any damage points were allocated to the target this phase. On a 3+, the target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

heroicTraits.name: Silver Summoner
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^WARFLOCK ARCANITE^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 12" of a friendly **ARGENT SHARD** that is visible to this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Grand Illusionist
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit was set up this turn, it can move D3". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

artifacts.name: Fate Slicer
artifacts.effect: Gain 1 **fate point** if any models were slain by this unit this turn.

artifacts.name: Cloaked in Wyrdflame
artifacts.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit.

artifacts.name: Kairic Tome
artifacts.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^SPELL^^** ability for a **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** unit wholly within 6" of this unit
artifacts.effect: Add 1 to or subtract 1 from the casting roll for that spell. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **^^SPELL^^** ability.

artifacts.name: Mutating Blade
artifacts.effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons. That weapon’s Attacks characteristic is 2D6 for the rest of the battle.

artifacts.name: Arcane Siphon
artifacts.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible **^^MANIFESTATION^^** (friendly or enemy) that was not set up this turn and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• The target is banished.
• **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the target’s Health characteristic.

artifacts.name: Spell-Catcher Amulet
artifacts.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: This unit can use this ability if any enemy **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^** were banished this phase.
artifacts.effect: This unit can use a **^^SUMMON^^** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition. That **^^SUMMON^^** ability does not count towards the total number of **^^SPELL^^** or **^^BANISH^^** abilities this unit can use this phase.

artifacts.name: The Five Verses of Volarian
artifacts.effect: This unit has a Move characteristic of 14" and has **^^FLY^^**.

artifacts.name: The Searing Eye
artifacts.timing: Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit wholly within 12" of this unit
artifacts.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, roll a dice. If the roll is the same as any of the dice in the casting roll, that spell is miscast. Otherwise, add the roll to the casting roll.

artifacts.name: Tome of Scorched Insight
artifacts.timing: Reaction: You declared a non-SUMMON SPELL ability for this unit
artifacts.effect: Change the casting roll for that spell to a value of 12 that cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound and this unit cannot use that **^^SPELL^^** ability again for the rest of the battle.

otherEnhancements.name: Vision of Defiant Supremacy
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
otherEnhancements.effect: If you won the priority roll this battle round and chose for your opponent to take the first turn or if your opponent seized the initiative this battle round, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Vision of Arcane Sacrifice
otherEnhancements.effect:
While units (friendly or enemy) are within 6" of this unit:
• Add 1 to unbinding rolls for those units.
• Spells cast by those units are miscast on an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less.
The first time this unit is destroyed, gain D6 **fate points**.

otherEnhancements.name: Vision of Destined Conquest
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Your Turn
otherEnhancements.effect:
If this unit is contesting an objective that you control that is wholly outside friendly territory:
• If you are the **underdog**, gain 1 **fate point** for each command point you have.
• If you are not the **underdog**, roll a dice for each command point you have. For each 3+, gain 1 **fate point**.

battleTraits.name: Form Up!
battleTraits.timing: Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare:
Pick a friendly **^^CITIES OF SIGMAR^^** unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly **^^CITIES OF SIGMAR^^** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.
**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal’ or ‘Cannonade Cogfort’.*

battleTraits.name: Take Aim!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **under orders** to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Pick 1 of that unit’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Sound the Attack!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for a unit that is under orders
battleTraits.effect: You can change the lowest D6 in the charge roll to match the highest D6.

battleTraits.name: Hurl Them Back!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **under orders** and in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons.

battleTraits.name: Into Them, You Dogs!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^HERO^^** that is **under orders** to use this ability. That unit is the **field officer** for the rest of the turn. Then, pick 2 other visible friendly non‑**^^HERO^^** units that are **under orders** and wholly within 12" of the **field officer** to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time the **field officer** uses a **^^FIGHT^^** ability, you can pick a target that has not used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability this turn. That target is **inspirited** and the other target is **emboldened**. The **inspirited** target can be picked to use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability immediately after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability used by the **field officer** has been resolved. Then, if the **emboldened** target has not used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability this turn, it can be picked to use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability immediately after the **inspirited** target’s **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

heroicTraits.name: Cosmopolitan Leader
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY^^** or **^^CAVALRY^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. If this unit is **^^HUMAN^^**, pick up to 3 eligible units to be the targets instead.
heroicTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn:
• If the target is **^^HUMAN^^**, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
• If the target is **^^DUARDIN^^**, add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• If the target is **^^AELF^^**, add 3 to the target’s control score.

heroicTraits.name: Draw Steel!
heroicTraits.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a friendly **^^CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN^^** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Astute Tactician
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^CITIES OF SIGMAR^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target and add 2 to run rolls for the target.

heroicTraits.name: Stentorian General
heroicTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with any visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

heroicTraits.name: Grizzled Drillmaster
heroicTraits.effect: Other visible friendly units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

heroicTraits.name: Beloved Leader
heroicTraits.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls applied by enemy abilities for attacks made by visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

heroicTraits.name: Pious Veteran
heroicTraits.effect: Each time you pick targets while declaring a **^^PRAYER^^** ability used by a friendly **^^CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST^^**, if this unit is eligible to be picked, you can pick it to be an additional target.

heroicTraits.name: Bristling Attitude
heroicTraits.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^CHARGE^^** ability for a visible unit within 12" of this unit
heroicTraits.effect: Spend any number of **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, roll **X** dice, where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the charge roll.

heroicTraits.name: Cosmopolitan Leader
heroicTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non‐**^^WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
heroicTraits.effect: Spend 1 **rage dice** for each target. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to wound rolls for each target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

artifacts.name: Bones of Saint Ignifus
artifacts.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^SPELL^^** or **^^PRAYER^^** ability for a visible unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders
artifacts.effect: Add 1 to the casting roll or chanting roll for that ability.

artifacts.name: The Last Blade of Embergard
artifacts.effect: This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons. Add 2 to that weapon’s Attacks characteristic and Rend characteristic for the rest of the battle.

artifacts.name: The Sphere Celestial
artifacts.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of this unit and more than 3" from all other units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features to be the target point. Then, pick another visible friendly **^^CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY^^** or **^^CAVALRY HERO^^** that is wholly within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target unit.
artifacts.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target unit and not in combat. Then, remove the target unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat. This unit and the target unit can use **^^MOVE^^** abilities in the following movement phase (this is an exception to Core Rules, 24.0).

otherEnhancements.name: Prototype Arco-Combustor Uninhibitor
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
otherEnhancements.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 3" to this unit’s Move characteristic.
• This unit can use **^^SHOOT^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RETREAT^^** ability in the same turn.
•No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^RETREAT^^** abilities.

otherEnhancements.name: Emergency Bellows
otherEnhancements.effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.

otherEnhancements.name: Grapple-Net Launcher
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Combat Phase
otherEnhancements.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Twin-Tailed Comet of Honour
otherEnhancements.effect: While this unit has any champions, add 5 to this unit’s control score.

otherEnhancements.name: The Living City Cross
otherEnhancements.effect: While this unit has any champions, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Aqshian Order of Merit
otherEnhancements.effect: While this unit has any champions, if an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, when resolving attacks as part of that ability, on an unmodified hit roll of 6, do not inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each unit in combat with that unit.

battleTraits.name: Form Up, Iron March!
battleTraits.timing: Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare:
Pick a friendly **IRON MARCH** unit to use this ability, then pick either 1 or 2 other visible friendly **IRON MARCH** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.
**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Cannonade Cogfort’ or ‘Mallus Forgepriest’.*

otherEnhancements.name: Castellan-Captain Vyan Philsin
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IRON MARCH INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

otherEnhancements.name: Commodore De Graçon
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit and up to 1 other friendly **IRON MARCH WAR MACHINE** within this unit’s combat range can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

otherEnhancements.name: Castellan-Captain Regan Vandercloud
otherEnhancements.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• The target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Engineer Kirsta Loudren
otherEnhancements.effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice for each visible unit (friendly and enemy) within its combat range. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

otherEnhancements.name: Engineer Gurrn Ashbrow
otherEnhancements.effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

otherEnhancements.name: Engineer Bartel Holst
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^** and **STRIKE-LAST**.

otherEnhancements.name: Battle-Priest Solantra Whyl
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit has **PRIEST (1)**.

otherEnhancements.name: Broadmoore and Louse
otherEnhancements.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Crew’s Leadshotters**. In addition, if this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can set up a **Freeguild Marshal and Relic Envoy** wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. That unit has the **IRON MARCH** keyword.

otherEnhancements.name: Master Sapper Gravelock Fiske
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit’s ranged weapons have **Anti‑FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend)** and **Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**.

battleTraits.name: Form up, Allies!
battleTraits.timing: Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare:
Pick a friendly **^^ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES^^** unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly **^^ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES^^** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
