• must each be a different unit type.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.
**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal’ or ‘Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard’.*

battleTraits.name: Forces of Order
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While 3 friendly **^^ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES^^** units are wholly within 12" of each other and 1 of those units has the **^^AELF^^** keyword, 1 of those units has the **^^DUARDIN^^** keyword and 1 of those units has the **^^SIGMARITE^^** keyword:
• Those units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** against shooting attacks.
• Add 3 to those units’ control scores.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks.

heroicTraits.name: Respected Commander
heroicTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a visible **^^ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES^^** unit wholly within 18" of this unit
heroicTraits.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

artifacts.name: Signet of the City
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick this unit and each visible friendly **^^ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES^^** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
artifacts.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• The targets are **under orders**.
• The targets have **^^Ward (6+)^^**.
• The targets have a maximum control score of 1.

battleTraits.name: Arcane Immunity
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Friendly **NULL MYRIAD** units have **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage points inflicted by **^^SPELL^^** abilities, **^^PRAYER^^** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS.**

battleTraits.name: Supernatural Absorption
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy **^^MANIFESTATION^^** within a friendly **NULL MYRIAD** unit's combat range to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• The target is banished and removed from play.
• If that friendly unit is damaged, **Heal (X)** that friendly unit, where **X** is the target's Health characteristic.
• If that friendly unit is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to **X,** where **X** is the target's Health characteristic.

battleTraits.name: First of the Mortarchs
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
Each time you make a casting roll for a friendly **Arkhan the Black,** if all the following are true, that spell cannot be unbound:
• The unmodified casting roll contains 2 or more results of the same value.
• The casting roll equals or exceeds the spell's casting value.
• The spell is not miscast.

heroicTraits.name: Aura of Enervation
heroicTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **NULL MYRIAD** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Gothizzar Cartouche
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **NULL MYRIAD** units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: The Voice and the Talon
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: The friendly **Synessa** and **Dexcessa** have the **TWIN** keyword.

battleTraits.name: The More Glorious Slaughter
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: If a friendly **TWIN** destroyed an enemy unit in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by units in the regiment of the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: The Longer Shadow
battleTraits.timing: Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: If a friendly **TWIN** is contesting an objective you control and the other is not, pick the one that is not to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is contesting an objective you control, add 5 to the control scores of units in its regiment.

battleTraits.name: The Grander Visage
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: If either friendly **TWIN** is damaged, pick the one with fewer or no damage points to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the unit using this ability has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.

battleTraits.name: The Swifter Surge
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: If a friendly **TWIN** charged in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for units in the regiment of the unit using this ability, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

battleTraits.name: The More Cunning Ruse
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: If both friendly **TWINS** are within 12" of and visible to each other, pick one of them to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Remove the unit using this ability from the battlefield and set it up on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Tethered to the Twins
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **TWIN** that has been destroyed to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

artifacts.name: The Triplet Trinket
artifacts.effect:
While a friendly **TWIN** is within 3" of and visible to this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that **TWIN** and this unit.
While 2 friendly **TWINS** are within 3" of and visible to this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target those **TWINS** and this unit instead.

battleTraits.name: Perfection Made Manifest
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick the friendly **Sigvald** to use this ability then pick a visible unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of him to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For each model slain by this ability this turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the friendly **Sigvald**’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Petulant Wrath
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: If the friendly **Sigvald** is not in combat and did not charge this turn, pick him to use this ability, then pick another friendly **^^DECADENT HOST^^** unit within 1" of him to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. Before removing any slain models from play, remove the friendly **Sigvald** from the battlefield then set him up again within 1" of the target.

battleTraits.name: Infernal Handmaidens
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: While the friendly **Sigvald** is within 3" of and visible to any friendly **^^DECADENT HOST DAEMON^^** units, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by those **^^DAEMON^^** units.

battleTraits.name: All for the Prince
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While the friendly **Sigvald** is within the combat range of another friendly **^^DECADENT HOST SYBARITE^^** unit:
• He has **WARD (2+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for him, allocate 1 damage point to another friendly **^^DECADENT HOST^^** unit within his combat range after the damage sequence for him has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battleTraits.name: Important People Have Important Places To Be
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: If the friendly **Sigvald** is not contesting an objective, he can move 2D6" but must end that move contesting an objective. He can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

battleTraits.name: The Prince in the Mirror
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: If the friendly **Sigvald** has been destroyed, pick him to be the target. He can be replaced even if he is a replacement unit.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a friendly **Contorted Epitome** and not in combat.

heroicTraits.name: Protégé
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'The Prince in the Mirror' ability
heroicTraits.effect: You can set up a replacement **Sigvald** within 1" of this unit instead of within 6" of a friendly **Contorted Epitome**. If you do so, after setting up that replacement unit, this unit is automatically destroyed.

artifacts.name: Mirror-Plate
artifacts.effect:
Weapons used by this unit have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 1.
While this unit is within 3" of and visible to the friendly **Sigvald**, add 20 to the friendly **Sigvald**’s control score.

battleTraits.name: Fall From Grace
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
A friendly non-**^^UNIQUE PARAGON^^** immediately loses the **^^PARAGON^^** keyword when any of the following happen:
• That **^^PARAGON^^** has 3 or more damage points allocated to it by the same use of a non‑**^^ATTACK^^** ability.
• That **^^PARAGON^^** uses a **^^CHARGE^^** ability and the unmodified charge roll is 5 or less (after any re‑rolls).
• A spell cast by that **^^PARAGON^^** is **miscast** (after any re-rolls).

battleTraits.name: Sensuous Arcana
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^UNIQUE PARAGON^^** that has successfully cast a spell this turn and has not used a **^^TEMPTATION^^** ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a **^^PARAGON^^**, add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: Cutting Barbs
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO^^** that has not used a **^^TEMPTATION^^** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with that **^^HERO^^** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
If the unit using this ability is a **^^PARAGON^^**, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.
***Rise to the Insults***: For the rest of the turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1.
***Turn Aside from the Insults***: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** units that target that enemy unit.

battleTraits.name: Chief of Revels
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^UNIQUE PARAGON^^** that charged this turn and has not used a **^^TEMPTATION^^** ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a **^^PARAGON^^**, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: Enthralling Vanity
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO^^** unit that has not used a **^^TEMPTATION^^** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that **^^HERO^^** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
If the unit using this ability is a **^^PARAGON^^**, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.
***Mesmerised***: For the rest of the turn, weapons used by friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** units for attacks that target that unit, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
***Break their Gaze***: For the rest of the turn, other than the **Companion** ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by the target have no effect.

battleTraits.name: Excess of Agility
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^UNIQUE PARAGON^^** that has not used a **^^TEMPTATION^^** ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, while the unit using this ability is a **^^PARAGON^^** and is in combat, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target visible friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: Beguiling Glance
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO^^** unit that has not used a **^^TEMPTATION^^** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that **^^HERO^^** to be the target.

battleTraits.name: Paragons of Slaanesh
battleTraits.timing: Start of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **^^PARAGONS^^** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** unit that does not have the **^^PARAGON^^** keyword and has not had the **^^PARAGON^^** keyword this battle to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
The target gains the **^^PARAGON^^** keyword.
**Designer’s Note:** *Friendly units with the **^^PARAGON^^*** *keyword on their warscroll count towards the* *number of friendly **^^PARAGONS^^** on the battlefield.* *If there are more than 3 friendly **^^PARAGONS^^** on the* *battlefield at the same time, you must immediately* *remove those units from the battlefield one at a time* *until there are only 3 friendly **^^PARAGONS^^** left on* *the battlefield.*

heroicTraits.name: The Need For Perfection
heroicTraits.effect: The first time each turn that an unmodified charge roll, casting roll, unbinding roll or banishment roll for a friendly non-**EUPHORIC** unit wholly within 12" of this unit is 5 or less, that unit has the **EUPHORIC** keyword for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Celebrity Warlord
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^HERO SYBARITE^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Master of Temptation
heroicTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if your opponent has any **temptation dice**. Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, while your opponent has not used any of their **temptation dice** to replace a roll for the target this turn, the target can only use **^^CORE^^** abilities.

heroicTraits.name: Dilettante
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
heroicTraits.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Unseemly Vitality
heroicTraits.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Centre of Attention
heroicTraits.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, while this unit is wholly within 12" of the centre of the battlefield and visible to the target:
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target other friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** units.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** units that target that enemy unit.

heroicTraits.name: Agonisingly Elusive
heroicTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect:
If it is your turn, apply the effect below. If it is your opponent’s turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit must move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

heroicTraits.name: Arcane Magnetism
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit has 3 or more damage points, it can use a **^^SPELL^^** ability as if it were your hero phase, as if that ability had the **^^UNLIMITED^^** keyword and as if this unit had **WIZARD (1)**.

heroicTraits.name: Incensed
heroicTraits.declare: Pick an objective within 6" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** units are not visible to enemy units more than 9" from them while all models in those friendly units are contesting the target objective.

artifacts.name: Bashful Visage
artifacts.effect: While they are wholly within 6" of this unit, friendly non-**^^MONSTER^^** non-**^^WAR MACHINE^^**^^ ^^**^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

artifacts.name: Crown of the Ur-Slaanesh
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^HERO INFANTRY^^**^^ ^^**^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

artifacts.name: The Rod of Misrule
artifacts.declare: Pick another visible friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: For the rest of the turn, when the target uses the ‘Power Through’ command, you can pick an enemy target for that command that does not have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using that command.

otherEnhancements.name: Obsession with Form
otherEnhancements.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Run' ability for this unit
otherEnhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Obsession with Control
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while this unit is contesting the target objective:
• This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
• Add 5 to this unit’s control score.

otherEnhancements.name: Obsession with Pain
otherEnhancements.effect: If this unit is damaged, spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Entropic Screech
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^RUINATION CHAMBER MONSTER^^** that has not used any **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with it to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. The unit using this ability cannot use any more **^^RAMPAGE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Hallowed Presence
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: While friendly **^^WARRIOR CHAMBER^^** units are wholly within 12" of any friendly **^^RUINATION CHAMBER^^** units, those friendly **^^WARRIOR CHAMBER^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

battleTraits.name: Ancient Aura
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army) Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^RUINATION CHAMBER^^** unit.
battleTraits.effect: That unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Temper the Flaw
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability at the end of each turn. Each friendly non-**^^HERO RUINATION CHAMBER^^** unit that used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability this turn is a target.
battleTraits.effect:
For each target, pick 1 of the following effects:
• ***Guided:*** If the target is wholly within 12" of any friendly **^^RUINATION CHAMBER HEROES^^**, return 1 slain model to it.
• ***Tormented:*** If the target is not wholly within 12" of any friendly **RUINATIONS CHAMBER HEROES**, it becomes tormented until the end of the next turn. While a unit is tormented, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons but it cannot contest objectives or use commands.

heroicTraits.name: Corven Lord
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit has the 'Ruination Chamber', ability, it can use that ability once per turn regardless of whether another friendly unit has used it during the same turn.

artifacts.name: Hallowed Scrolls
artifacts.effect: If this unit is **^^INFANTRY^^**, it has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. Otherwise, it has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

battleTraits.name: Gruesome Devourers
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by a friendly **MEATFIST** unit’s combat attacks to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use **^^RETREAT^^** abilities.

battleTraits.name: The Unstoppable Feast
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **MEATFIST** unit that has not used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability this battle to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RUN^^** or **^^RETREAT^^** ability earlier in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Gluttonous Conquerors
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Control characteristic of friendly **MEATFIST** units while they are in combat.

battleTraits.name: Greedy Chompers
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **MEATFIST** units that are in combat to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, **Heal (X)** the target where **X** is equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: Bloodthirsty Arrogance
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets a friendly **MEATFIST INFANTRY** unit that did not charge in the same turn, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

battleTraits.name: Fleshy Stampede
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 2 to run rolls for friendly **MEATFIST** units.

battleTraits.name: Meaty Charge
battleTraits.timing: Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **MEATFIST** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this phase to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Make a meaty charge roll by rolling a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll made this turn for the unit using this ability. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability has more models than the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

heroicTraits.name: Thick Blubber
heroicTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Overpowering Mass
heroicTraits.effect: When making meaty charge rolls for this unit, you can re-roll unmodified rolls of 1.

heroicTraits.name: Force of Savage Personality
heroicTraits.effect: Enemy units and enemy **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^** cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

artifacts.name: Snott, Gnoblar Thief
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^HERO^^** that has any artefacts of power to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or lower than the current battle round number, the target no longer has any artefacts of power.

artifacts.name: Trapper's Arsenal
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Rusty Leadbelcher Gun
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
artifacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect:
Pick to load the gun with **Jagged Shrapnel** or **Lumpen Metal**^^ ^^**Scrap**, then apply the corresponding effect below:
***Jagged Shrapnel:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models were slain by that mortal damage, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
***Lumpen Metal Scrap:*** Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: Fried Limbs
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 3 to charge rolls for friendly **GOLLOP** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

battleTraits.name: Prepare the Feast
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: If there is no friendly **Feastmaster** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GOLLOP HERO** to be the **Feastmaster** for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Ooh, That Looks Tasty...
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, you gain a number of **raw ingredients**.
The number of **raw ingredients** yielded by a destroyed unit is the Health characteristic of that unit multiplied by the number of starting models in that unit.
**Designer’s Note:** *If a destroyed enemy unit had a Health characteristic of 2 and its starting size was 10 models, it would yield 20 raw ingredients when it was destroyed.*

battleTraits.name: Gland Goulash
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, when making casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly **GOLLOP** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

battleTraits.name: Bone-Slurry Soup
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Spend 5 **raw ingredients**.
battleTraits.effect: **HEAL (D6)** each friendly **GOLLOP** unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

battleTraits.name: The Organ Platter
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Spend 20 **raw ingredients**.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **Feastmaster**, melee weapons used by friendly **GOLLOP** units have **Crit (Mortal)**.

battleTraits.name: Gore-Offal Dumplings
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.
battleTraits.effect: Each friendly **GOLLOP** unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster** can immediately use a **^^CHARGE^^** ability as if it were your charge phase, but subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making the charge roll for that unit.

battleTraits.name: Unwashed Innards
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Spend 5 **raw ingredients**.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 4 to run rolls for friendly **GOLLOP** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

heroicTraits.name: Indomitable Guts
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to ward rolls for this unit.

artifacts.name: Overflowing Larder
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: Gain D6 **raw ingredients**. If this unit is a **Feastmaster**, gain D3+3 **raw ingredients** instead.

battleTraits.name: A Clan of Hunters
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **Hunters with Sabrefangs** unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: The target can use the ‘Through the Frosts’ ability even if another friendly **Hunters with Sabrefangs** unit has used that ability this battle.

battleTraits.name: Grasp of the Everwinter
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with any friendly **ALFROSTUN** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: Run 'Em Down
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
Each time an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **ALFROSTUN** unit uses a **^^RETREAT^^** ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
**Designer’s Note:** *This mortal damage is in addition to any mortal damage inflicted on that enemy unit by that* **^^RETREAT^^** *ability.*

battleTraits.name: Fearsome Breed
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of a friendly **ALFROSTUN MONSTER**. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of a friendly **ALFROSTUN MONSTER** instead.

battleTraits.name: Masked by the Endless White
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Friendly **ALFROSTUN** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" away.

heroicTraits.name: Hard-Bitten Chieftain
heroicTraits.effect: Other than the **Companion** ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target this unit made by enemy units that charged in the same turn have no effect.

artifacts.name: Alvagr Rune-Tokens
artifacts.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
artifacts.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2 to chanting rolls for friendly **ALFROSTUN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

battleTraits.name: Argy Bargy
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^BIG^^** or **^^LITTLE^^** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.
• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• If the target is **building momentum**, it is no longer **building momentum** and is **getting ready** for the rest of the turn instead.
• For the rest of the turn, each time the target makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

battleTraits.name: Take A Run At It
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^BIG^^** or **^^LITTLE^^** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.
• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• The target is **building momentum** for the rest of the turn.
• If the target is within 3" of a battlefield edge, remove it from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **beyond the horizon**.
• For the rest of the phase, the target can pass through enemy models and terrain features when using **^^MOVE^^** abilities as if it had **^^FLY^^**.

battleTraits.name: The Big One
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^BIG^^** or **^^LITTLE^^** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.
• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• If the target is **prepping the big one**, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll any number of dice. If any of the rolls are a 1, the target is no longer **prepping the big one**. Otherwise, add the results together, then inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the total.

battleTraits.name: Haring Back
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: If a friendly unit is in reserve **beyond the horizon**, you must pick that unit to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If it is not possible to set it up, it wanders off and is automatically destroyed.

battleTraits.name: Wrathful Rampage
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^SONS OF BEHEMAT^^** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.
• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• If the target is **^^LITTLE^^** and is **getting ready**, it is no longer **getting ready** and has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn instead.
• If the target is **^^BIG^^** and is **getting ready**, it is no longer **getting ready**. Instead, either it has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn or it is **prepping the big one** for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Grabby
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit contesting an objective you do not control.

heroicTraits.name: Mega-Grump
heroicTraits.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** while it has 25 or more damage points.

heroicTraits.name: Terrifying Hulk
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Your opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a visible non-MONSTER enemy unit within 12" of this unit
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can change one of the dice in that charge roll to a 1.

heroicTraits.name: Brute of Brutes
heroicTraits.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks.

heroicTraits.name: Spell-Chomper
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can use **^^UNBIND^^** and **^^BANISH^^** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. In addition, each time an enemy **^^MANIFESTATION^^** within this unit's combat range is banished, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Always First In
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can move 2D6". It must end that move more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Thundering Titan
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
heroicTraits.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a non-**^^HERO^^** enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, this unit cannot be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target while there are other friendly **^^SONS OF BEHEMAT^^** units in combat with the target.

heroicTraits.name: Unreasonable Tyrant
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
heroicTraits.declare: Pick another visible friendly **^^SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: One-Hit Wonder
heroicTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can make a pile-in move. Then, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for cach battle round in which this unit was on the battlefield in both combat phases and did not use any **^^FIGHT^^** abilities. On a 6+, inflict 4D6 mortal damage on the target.

artifacts.name: Enchanted Portcullis
artifacts.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).

artifacts.name: Mantle of the Wood-Kings
artifacts.effect: If this unit charged in the same turn, while it is in combat with 2 or more enemy units, add 1 to hit rolls for its combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

artifacts.name: Massive Stuffin' Sack
artifacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artifacts.effect: Roll 3 dice. For each roll that is at least double the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain.

artifacts.name: Krakenskin Sandals
artifacts.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic, Rend characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit's **Almighty Stomp**.

artifacts.name: Protecty Bits
artifacts.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

artifacts.name: Glowy Lantern
artifacts.effect: If this unit is a **^^WIZARD^^** or **^^PRIEST^^**, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the battle. Otherwise, pick either the **WIZARD (1)** or **PRIEST (1)** keyword. This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.

otherEnhancements.name: Up For It
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.

otherEnhancements.name: That Boy's not Right
otherEnhancements.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, this unit can use a Prayer ability from the prayer lore you picked during army composition as if it had **PRIEST (1)**. Instead of making a chanting roll for that prayer, the chanting roll is 5 and cannot be modified.

otherEnhancements.name: Always on Guard
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Battered Shrimp
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy non-**^^MONSTER HERO^^** in combat with this unit to be the target
otherEnhancements.effect: Both players roll off. If you win the roll-off, roll off again. Keep rolling off in this way until you lose the roll-off. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of roll-offs made as part of this ability that you won this turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Earthshaking Roar
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Hammer Throw
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
otherEnhancements.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **Mancrusher Gargant** within its combat range to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect:
Roll 3D6. On a 4+, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within a number of inches of this unit equal to the roll and visible to this unit. It can be set up in combat. The target cannot use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.
If the target is set up in combat:
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target.
• The target has charged this turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Colossal Slam
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy **^^MONSTER^^** or **^^WAR MACHINE^^** that has no more than 1 model and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect:
If 2 or more friendly **^^BIG^^** or **^^LITTLE^^** units are in combat with the target, apply the effect below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target has a higher Health characteristic than this unit. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again in combat with this unit. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

otherEnhancements.name: Rancid Flatulence
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
otherEnhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Windmill Walloping
otherEnhancements.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick an enemy **^^MONSTER^^** or **^^WAR MACHINE^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. Add 1 to each roll for each consecutive turn in which the target was picked to be the target of this ability. For each 6+, allocate 1 mortal damage to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battleTraits.name: Stompin' About
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: That **^^LITTLE^^** unit can move D6+3". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit that has a lower Health characteristic than that **^^LITTLE^^** unit and that it passed across during that move.

battleTraits.name: Stomp! Stomp! Stomp! Stomp!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **^^STOMPER TRIBE^^** unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each friendly **^^STOMPER TRIBE^^** model in combat with the target.
On a 5+:
• The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
• Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: Get In There, You Runts!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^LITTLE^^** unit that is within a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit's combat range, visible to it and not in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn, and the target has **^^FLY^^** for the rest of the phase.

battleTraits.name: Grab Those Rocks and Chuck 'Em!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick each friendly **^^LITTLE^^** unit wholly within 18" of and visible to a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit and not in combat to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Gettin' Stuck In
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^STOMPER TRIBE^^** unit in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
If the target is **LITTLE,** pick a model in the target unit. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that model's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
If the target is **BIG,** add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Absolutely Fuming
heroicTraits.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Almighty Stomp** if it did not use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability in the previous turn.

heroicTraits.name: Eager for the Fight
heroicTraits.effect: When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

artifacts.name: Club of the First Oak
artifacts.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

artifacts.name: Sparky Shield
artifacts.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit, friendly **^^STOMPER TRIBE^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.

otherEnhancements.name: Future Stomper
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit can use the 'Power Through' command even if it has not charged this turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Carefully Watched
otherEnhancements.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
otherEnhancements.effect: Pick a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit that has not used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability immediately after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit and the target for the rest of the turn.

otherEnhancements.name: Little Hopper
otherEnhancements.effect: This unit can be picked to use the 'Stompin' About' ability even if it is not wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit.

otherEnhancements.name: Keen Bean
otherEnhancements.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **^^BIG^^** unit, it can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RUN^^** ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: I've Heard She Can...
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
***... Shoot Fire From Her Eyes!:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible enemy unit within 12" of the friendly **Ma Maegran.**
... ***Turn You Into a Human!:*** Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the friendly **Ma Maegran.** Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with that unit.
***... Make Ya Big and Strong!:*** Pick another visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the friendly **Ma Maegran.** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's weapons for the rest of the turn.
. . . ***Whiz the Biggest Bangers!:*** Add 1 to casting rolls for the friendly **Ma Maegran** until the start of your next turn.

battleTraits.name: Oi! Gerroff!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: If the friendly **Ma Maegran** is in combat and damaged, pick up to 3 friendly **Mancrusher Gargants** on the battlefield that are visible to her to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Each target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Summon the Herd
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: If the friendly **Ma Maegran** is on the battlefield, pick each enemy **non-FLY non-MONSTER** unit that is visible to her to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a number of dice for each target equal to the current battle round number. For each 4+, allocate **1** mortal damage to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battleTraits.name: Don't Let Nuffin' Happen To Her!
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While the friendly **Ma Maegran** is within the combat range of another friendly **^^LITTLE^^** unit:
• She has **WARD (5+).**
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for her, allocate 1 mortal damage to another friendly **^^LITTLE^^** unit within her combat range after the damage sequence for her has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
• Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for that other friendly **^^LITTLE^^** unit's combat attacks.

otherEnhancements.name: Butt of the Lash
otherEnhancements.effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Ma Maegran,** remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within her combat range. This unit can only be set up in combat with enemy units that are in combat with the friendly **Ma Maegran.**

otherEnhancements.name: Ghyranite Whirlstone
otherEnhancements.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^MATRIARCH'S MOB^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
otherEnhancements.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target.
